Imperial Dragon Emissary Dedication.name: Imperial Dragon Emissary Dedication
Imperial Dragon Emissary Dedication.description:
As an imperial dragon’s personal representative, you gain a direct connection to your dragon ally. Your dragon ally has the ability to communicate with you from any place and observe you at all times, not unlike how a deity can observe their clerics. Once per day, you can concentrate on your connection to your dragon to open a line of communication through telepathy that lasts for 1 minute. When the link is open, your body becomes unconscious and you project your consciousness to a mindscape that your dragon has control over. This produces the effects of an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.41TZEjhO6D1nWw2X]{Augury} spell of a rank equal to half your level rounded up.

You can also call on your dragon’s power to channel your dragon into your body. You gain the channel imperial dragon focus spell. You can Refocus by communing with your dragon, usually while performing tasks it approves of or that would be appropriate for its edicts and anathema.

Tsering Rafflesiacaeae Flower (Fruiting).name: Tsering Rafflesiacaeae Flower (Fruiting)
Tsering Rafflesiacaeae Flower (Fruiting).description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

Members of the Foraging Guild rush to harvest this beautiful flower during the one brief time they bloom, the only plant that thrives when Zi Ha’s harsh environment. When consumed, you gain resistance 10 to damage from hazardous terrain and environmental hazards for 15 minute. You also gain the Stink Breath ability.

Stink Breath 1 (olfactory) Frequency once per minute; Requirements You are under the effects of a tsering rafflesiaceae flower

Effect You expel the smell of the flower with one big belch. Each creature in a @Template[type:cone|distance:10] in front of you must make a @Check[fortitude|dc:38] save and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} on a failure or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure.

Dragon Flight.name: Dragon Flight
Dragon Flight.description: Your dragon ally shares the ability to soar through the air. While you’re channeling your imperial dragon, you gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed.

Glimpse the Past.name: Glimpse the Past
Glimpse the Past.description: Your sky dragon imparts upon you a pertinent moment from a previous incarnation, granting you knowledge from a life long departed. Choose three Lore skills during your daily preparations. You become trained in these skills until your next daily preparations. If you were already trained in that skill, you instead become an expert in that skill until your next daily preparations.

Synchronized Aerial Assault.name: Synchronized Aerial Assault
Synchronized Aerial Assault.description: You fight in tandem with your eagle, shooting at your foes while its talons shred their eyes. You Command your eagle to Fly once. Until the start of your next turn, your ranged Strikes that damage a creature that your eagle was adjacent to at any point during this Fly action also deal @Damage[2d6[persistent,bleed]] damage, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} until it removes the bleed damage.

Banga Balance.name: Banga Balance
Banga Balance.description: The steps of a dance in battle requires balance, a fact which allows you to carry more than the strife of combat. With hands free to carry your signature weapons, you can gracefully negotiate a center of balance that cannot be broken by your enemies. You can carefully place a single item up to 3 Bulk on the top of your head and it does not count towards your Bulk, but you must Balance or Step to move instead of Stride while carrying an item in this way. If you Balance and you fail your Acrobatics check, you drop the item in an adjacent space instead of the normal effect. If you are a master in Acrobatics, you can place up to 2 items of up to 5 Bulk total on the top of your head, or up to 3 items of up to 10 Bulk total on the top of your head if you are legendary. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.misc.sOkZFGWjSHB1Mffw]{Banga Swap} free action.

prerequisites.value: Karenza Bladedancer Dedication or Maglalatik Dancer Dedication

Luong Phung's Trident (Greater).name: Luong Phung's Trident (Greater)
Luong Phung's Trident (Greater).description:
This elegant steel +2 striking returning trident is coated with scales that Luong Phung has shed throughout the years. The shaft is cool and soothing to touch, like gentle waves gliding over your hand.

Activate—Ring Tines 2 (manipulate, sonic) Frequency once per day

Effect Each creature within 15 feet takes @Damage[5d10[sonic]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:28|basic] save). Any creature that fails is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 round, or 1 hour on a critical failure.

Ginunting.name: Ginunting
Ginunting.description: Ginuntings are shaped like a beak as the tip of these swords are curved downward, allowing them to make wide sweeping attacks in quick succession.

Shei Long's Blade.name: Shei Long's Blade
Shei Long's Blade.description:
This +1 striking ghost touch katana is crafted from the bright jade ore that is the foundation of Zi Ha’s mountains. The blade is blessed by Tsukiyo’s moonlight, and its edge is infused with Shei Long’s tooth.

Activate—Judgement of the Sky r (manipulate, electricity) Trigger Your attack roll with Shei Long's blade is a critical sucess

Effect The judgment of the heavens flows from the blade. Your target takes @Damage[2d8[electricity]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}. All the target’s allies within 20 feet take @Damage[1d8[electricity]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:19|basic] Reflex save. Creatures who critically fail their save are slowed 1.

White Tiger's Shepherd.name: White Tiger's Shepherd
White Tiger's Shepherd.description:
In recent years, a group of Baekho worshippers have begun using hook swords, seeing their twin nature as a representation of his balance. Most of these followers venerate one of the Lord of the Seasons’ four claws. Whether trained by them or inspired by their work, you have followed in their footsteps. While wearing distinguishing clothing, usually a white linen robe over any armor, you are recognized as a White Tiger’s Shepherd. You become trained in Religion or another skill if you were already trained in Religion.

Your hook sword Strikes deal 1 additional spirit damage per weapon damage die or 2 additional spirit damage per weapon damage die if your hook sword Strike has a circumstance bonus to damage from the twin trait. Baekho’s favored weapon is the hook sword instead of katana for you.

If you have violated Baekho’s anathema, you lose the benefits of this feat and any feats that list it as a prerequisite until you atone.

Luong Phung's Trident (Major).name: Luong Phung's Trident (Major)
Luong Phung's Trident (Major).description:
This elegant steel +2 greater striking returning trident is coated with scales that Luong Phung has shed throughout the years. The shaft is cool and soothing to touch, like gentle waves gliding over your hand.

Activate—Ring Tines 2 (manipulate, sonic) Frequency once per day

Effect Each creature within 15 feet takes @Damage[7d10[sonic]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:34|basic] save). Any creature that fails is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 round, or 1 hour on a critical failure.

Condemn.name: Condemn
Condemn.description: Your kami cannot ignore others who actively blaspheme against the natural world, and it calls upon you to condemn them. You gain the Condemn reaction.

Tsering Rafflesiacaeae Flower (Budding).name: Tsering Rafflesiacaeae Flower (Budding)
Tsering Rafflesiacaeae Flower (Budding).description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

Members of the Foraging Guild rush to harvest this beautiful flower during the one brief time they bloom, the only plant that thrives when Zi Ha’s harsh environment. When consumed, you gain resistance 3 to damage from hazardous terrain and environmental hazards for 1 minute. You also gain the Stink Breath ability.

Stink Breath 1 (olfactory) Frequency once per minute; Requirements You are under the effects of a tsering rafflesiaceae flower

Effect You expel the smell of the flower with one big belch. Each creature in a @Template[type:cone|distance:10] in front of you must make a @Check[fortitude|dc:21] save and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} on a failure or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure.

Forest Dragon's Senses.name: Forest Dragon's Senses
Forest Dragon's Senses.description:
You have enhanced senses while channeling your forest dragon’s power. You have a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks while in a forest or when surrounded by large amounts of plant life.

While you are channeling your dragon, you can sense creatures carrying wood items with a total of 1 Bulk or greater as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet. If a creature is made of wood or has the plant or wood trait, you can detect it within 30 feet as a precise sense.

Displacing Waves.name: Displacing Waves
Displacing Waves.description:
Requirements You’re channeling your dragon.

You move with the power of crashing waves. You Stride or Swim. If you move at least 10 feet and end your movement adjacent to another creature, you can choose a single creature to be affected by a wave of water following you. The creature must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. Regardless of the result, the target is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success You push your target back 5 feet. You can Stride or Swim after it, but you must move the same distance and in the same direction.

Failure As success, except you push the target 10 feet and if they contact an obstacle or another creature they fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Critical Failure As failure, except you push the target 20 feet and they are knocked prone even if they do not contact an obstacle or another creature.

Wield the Storm.name: Wield the Storm
Wield the Storm.description:
Requirements Your last action or activity this turn had the electricity trait and you are channeling your dragon.

You build up electrical energy to discharge into foes. Choose an enemy within 15 feet, dealing @Damage[(6+max(0,(ceil((@actor.level -13)/2))))d6[electricity]] damage with a @Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic] save. A creature that fails their save is seized under the intense shock and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} for 1 round on a critical failure. At 14th level, and every 2 levels thereafter, increase your explosion's damage by 1d6.

Spirit of the Rushing River.name: Spirit of the Rushing River
Spirit of the Rushing River.description: Your kami assists you by transforming you into an elemental avatar of rushing waters that lasts for 1 minute. You are close to achieving your destiny, and like the waters of a raging river, nothing will stand in your way. This grants you the swarm and water traits, immunity to the immobilized, grabbed, and restrained conditions, you have resistance equal to half your level to fire and physical damage, and weakness equal to half your level to area and splash damage. You can fit into spaces only a few inches wide. You don't gain the swarm mind ability, so you're still affected normally by mental effects. As a swarm, you can't speak, cast spells, use manipulate actions requiring your hands, activate your magic items, or make any of your Strikes with your normal body. You gain the Torrential Flow action. You remain in this form for 1 minute or until you Dismiss the activation.

Multiversal Starlit God Form.name: Multiversal Starlit God Form
Multiversal Starlit God Form.description:
You can arise to an ultimate god-like form that channels the full power of the gods through you. Once per day, you can cast avatar as an arcane innate spell. Rather than a deity, you gain the following specific abilities instead.

Starlit God Form - Speed 30 feet, fly 70 feet; Melee 1 starstrike (deadly 3d6, finesse, reach 15 feet, silver, versatile b or s), Damage 6d8+6 piercing; Ranged 1 cosmic ray (range 120 feet, silver), Damage 6d6+3 force.

Pill Condensation.name: Pill Condensation
Pill Condensation.description: You can condense and purify your elixirs’ power much like you cultivate your qi, until what remains is a solid, encapsulated bundle of concentrated energy. When you create an elixir, you can prepare it as a pill instead. Creatures that consume a pill must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher and become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} on a failure or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure. You get a degree of success one better than you rolled for your saving throw against the sickened condition from consuming a pill. A pill loses the elixir trait, has double the duration of a normal elixir, and increases the die size of its effects by one step (to a maximum of d12), but the effects do not start until 1 round after the pill is consumed. A pill can be drawn and consumed as part of the same Interact action.

Clearing The Way.name: Clearing The Way
Clearing The Way.description:
Requirements You are wielding at least one sai.

You remove armed obstacles from your path. Either @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} and then @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.UHpkTuCtyaPqiCAB]{Step}, or Step and then Disarm. Additionally, if you Step into a space of an unattended weapon you successfully Disarmed, you can Interact to pick it up as a free action.

Hongali Horse Lord Dedication.name: Hongali Horse Lord Dedication
Hongali Horse Lord Dedication.description:
Acess You are from Hongal.

You treat the bow and horse like extensions of yourself. You gain a young animal companion that serves as your mount. You gain either a horse or yzobu animal companion. This animal companion has access to the following @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.misc.Item.FZdhmClqFVa9cNag]{support benefit} in addition to its normal support benefit. You must choose which benefit to gain when your animal companion uses the Support action.

Special If you already have an animal companion when you take this dedication, you gain the Horse Falconer archetype feat in addition to the effects of this feat, but your animal companion must be a horse or yzobu.

Soverign Armor.name: Soverign Armor
Soverign Armor.description:
Requirements You’re channeling your dragon.

Your call upon your sovereign dragon’s magic to create a magical shield that manifests as golden armor. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC until the beginning of your next turn. In addition, when a creature misses you with a Strike while your armor is protecting you, they must attempt a @Check[reflex|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. Creatures that fail their save are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round on a critical failure. A creature can Interact to remove the blinded and dazzled conditions.

Cultural Conducting.name: Cultural Conducting
Cultural Conducting.description: You are adept at immersing yourself in local culture to influence your performances. When you spend at least 1 day of downtime in a settlement learning from other lorekeepers and storytellers, you become trained in a Lore appropriate for that settlement (subject to GM discretion). If you are legendary in Performance, you are expert in this Lore instead of trained. In addition, when you Perform within the settlement you use aspects of their culture in your performance, granting you a +1 circumstance bonus to your check.

Serpentine Mirror.name: Serpentine Mirror
Serpentine Mirror.description:
This curved “mirror” made of polished serpentine stone from the Kelsang mountain range does not reflect so much as it focuses light. It simply looks like a glossy green pool of water until placed under direct sunlight, whereupon it focuses the rays into an intense beam.

Activate—Blinding Beam 1 (light, manipulate, visual) Requirements The mirror is held in 2 hands, and you’re under direct sunlight

Effect You carefully redirect the sun’s light via the mirror into the eyes of another creature. The target must make a @Check[reflex|dc:17] save to look away from the light, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round on a failure or 2 rounds on a critical failure.

Activate—Burning Beam 2 (fire, light, manipulate) Frequency once per 10 minutes; Requirements The mirror is held in at least 1 hand, and you’re under direct sunlight

Effect You focus the light on a creature within 30 feet to burn them. Attempt a ranged attack roll to deal @Damage[2d8[fire],2[persistent,fire]] damage on hit. The mirror then becomes too hot to hold for 10 minutes and deals @Damage[1[fire]] damage to any creature holding it at the start of their turn for the duration.

Supple Construction.name: Supple Construction
Supple Construction.description:
You are made of the still-supple clay mined from the area around the Cradle of Immortality. You gain resistance to bludgeoning damage equal to half your level.

Enhancement You gain resistance to precision damage and critical hits equal to half your level.

Dancing Parry.name: Dancing Parry
Dancing Parry.description:
Your dances become integrated with defensive maneuvers. While you are in your minatan dancer stance, you constantly have the benefits of Dueling Parry.

Special If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.player-options.GpFhzCywrH6E2XgQ]{Maglalatik Dancer Dedication}, you can grant the benefits of your parry to one adjacent ally instead of yourself while in maglalatik stance without having to Perform.

Nagajor Monsoon Expert Dedication.name: Nagajor Monsoon Expert Dedication
Nagajor Monsoon Expert Dedication.description:
Access Tian Xia origin

Rigorous training under the Serpent's Embrace has honed your body and mind to tackle almost any natural disaster. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.wYerMk6F1RZb0Fwt]{Battle Medicine} skill feat or another Medicine skill feat if you already had Battle Medicine. When you attempt to Swim and you roll a critical failure, you get a failure instead and you increase the maximum distance you can Swim by 10 feet. Lastly, you gain a +1 status bonus to saves against air or water effects.

Special If you have a swim Speed, you increase your swim Speed by 10 feet.

Overlooked.name: Overlooked
Overlooked.description:
Others tend to overlook objects, even when they know you’re around. When you’re in an environment with items roughly similar to your shape, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Stealth checks.

Additionally, when you take the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} action and succeed at your Stealth check, you don’t become observed if you don’t have cover or greater cover and aren’t concealed at the end of the Sneak action, as long as you have cover or greater cover or are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.tWS8aMCyeGKcnFh1]{Concealed} at the end of your turn.

Fearless Pride.name: Fearless Pride
Fearless Pride.description:
Access access to training from a biaoshi ranger

Many biaoshi, regardless of their origins, possess a stubborn pride beggaring that of more noble or well-heeled soldiers. You know failure leads to shame and eventual unemployment, not just for yourself but also for those who rely on you; to say nothing of any greater consequences of disappointing powerful clientele. Thus, even in the throes of terror, you prioritize your work above yourself, a fact which reassures those in your care. You gain a +2 status bonus to saves and DCs against fear effects from your prey and you do not take penalties to your attack rolls from the frightened condition against your prey.

Draining Empowerment.name: Draining Empowerment
Draining Empowerment.description: You empower your qi using dangerous techniques that leech extra life force to ensure you remain a constant threat. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.misc.38Ks1K36sOWumo2f]{Qi-Empowered Blows} and reduce your Hit Points by the maximum amount, if your empowered Strike is a failure, but not a critical failure, do not increase your multiple attack penalty.

Butting In.name: Butting In
Butting In.description:
Requirements You are wielding a Minatan weapon

A foe makes the mistake of ignoring you, and you immediately smash their hand with the butt of your weapon. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the Strike granted by Reactive Strike, and it now disrupts triggering ranged attacks and move actions on a critical hit, in addition to manipulate actions.

A Moment's Peace.name: A Moment's Peace
A Moment's Peace.description: You are able to condense down the songs into shorter pieces. You are able to perform the orchestration as a 10 minute activity instead of a 1 hour activity.

Forest Maker.name: Forest Maker
Forest Maker.description: You can assume the form of a great and spreading banyan tree. You gain the ability to cast one with plants as a primal innate spell at will. Once per day, if you cast one with plants while channeling your dragon, you can cause up to 10 trees to sprout from the ground spontaneously within 100 feet of you and are up to 50 feet high. Each tree is a 15-foot square that cannot overlap with one another, with the center square being obstructed by the trunk of the tree. Creatures within the bursts take @Damage[10d6[bludgeoning]] damage and must attempt a @Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic] save. Creatures that failed their save are carried to the top of the tree and then begin falling. If a creature succeeds its save but is occupying a space with a tree trunk, it is moved to an adjacent space as forced movement. These trees last as long as you are channeling your dragon, but if the trees are in soil when channel imperial dragon ends, they remain as ordinary, non-magical trees and continue to grow and thrive.

Tsering Rafflesiacaeae Flower (Blossomin.name: Tsering Rafflesiacaeae Flower (Blossoming)
Tsering Rafflesiacaeae Flower (Blossomin.description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

Members of the Foraging Guild rush to harvest this beautiful flower during the one brief time they bloom, the only plant that thrives when Zi Ha’s harsh environment. When consumed, you gain resistance 7 to damage from hazardous terrain and environmental hazards for 10 minute. You also gain the Stink Breath ability.

Stink Breath 1 (olfactory) Frequency once per minute; Requirements You are under the effects of a tsering rafflesiaceae flower

Effect You expel the smell of the flower with one big belch. Each creature in a @Template[type:cone|distance:10] in front of you must make a @Check[fortitude|dc:31] save and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} on a failure or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure.

Reborn in Clay.name: Reborn in Clay
Reborn in Clay.description:
Long hours practicing and connecting with yourself has allowed you to find yourself. You gain a 5th-level or lower ancestry feat from the ancestry you chose for Lingering Anamnesis.

Enhancement You gain a 9th-level or lower ancestry feat from the chosen ancestry as well.

Iron Rebuke.name: Iron Rebuke
Iron Rebuke.description:
Requirements You are wielding at least one sai.

You block your foe’s blow, deliver a punishing riposte to their wrist, yank their weapon to the side, and kick their feet out from under them. You attempt to Strike, followed by a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm}, and then a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} on the same creature each using your current multiple attack penalty. If your Strike is successful, your target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} until the start of your next turn. Each attack counts towards your multiple attack penalty, but doesn’t increase your penalty until you have made all three attacks.

Iron-Faced Impartiality.name: Iron-Faced Impartiality
Iron-Faced Impartiality.description:
A truly moral censor must not allow themselves to be moved by fear, greed, or other biases, even when impeaching Tian Xia’s well-connected and wealthy elites. Even the Emperors are not beyond criticism—a duty endowed upon censors approximately 1621 years prior by the first Shu Emperor. The path of a virtuous censor is one that cannot be swayed from the path of justice as afforded by the laws of the Celestial Court. You gain the circumstance bonus from Pursue a Lead on saving throws (and their DCs, as normal) against effects with the mental, spirit, or curse trait. At the end of each turn when you would reduce your frightened condition by 1, you reduce it by 2 instead.

Special If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.5cYFHKQK6OZCwavI]{Detective's Readiness} class feat, you gain the circumstance bonus from Pursue a Lead against effects with the mental, spirit, or curse traits even if they are not related to the question at the heart of an open investigation

Soul-Form.name: Soul-Form
Soul-Form.description:
You empower yourself with your soul armaments, empowering your body with size and strength. You manifest the essence form of all your soul armaments simultaneously, you can spend 1 Mythic Point to also gain the effects of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.wzctak6BxOW8xvFV]{Enlarge} spell. If you manifested the essence form of all three soul armaments, you gain the effects of a 4th-rank enlarge spell and resistance equal to your level to all damage.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.misc.NhaNSW8FMLP5YYKI]{Effect: Soul Form (Full Manifestation)}

Kawuk Sail.name: Kawuk Sail
Kawuk Sail.description: The large mummified remains of a Kawuk Spawn’s sail has retained its rigidity and hydrophobic nature due to being preserved upon dying in a bog. You can strap it on your back to acquire some of the power of the kaiju from which it came. You gain a +10-foot status bonus to your swim Speed if you have one or gain a swim Speed equal to your Speed if you don’t. You ignore difficult terrain from water or currents.

Phial of Zhulong (Major).name: Phial of Zhulong (Major)
Phial of Zhulong (Major).description:
Activate A Strike

This sphere of glass is filled with two separate liquids, a sickly yellow oil and the lurid green distilled saliva of an underworld dragon. It explodes into acrid sparks when shaken and thrown. Developed by the young underworld dragon Zhulong in their plan to siege the kishin oni Inma’s fortress, it is more damaging to objects than creatures. A phial of Zhulong deals the 3d8 acid damage and 4d4 persistent acid damage, but it deals double damage to inanimate objects that are not being held. Inanimate mundane objects that receive double damage also have their Hardness permanently reduced by 1 each time they are hit—if their Hardness would be reduced to less than 0, they gain a weakness to acid and fire damage equal to 1 or increase these values by 1 if they already had a weakness. Flammable objects within 5 feet of the bomb’s target immediately catch on fire, taking 1d4 fire damage each round until extinguished, regardless of the outcome of the bomb’s attack roll. Many types grant an item bonus to attack rolls.

Compass of Luong Phung.name: Compass of Luong Phung
Compass of Luong Phung.description:
Finding sea serpents isn't easy–unless you’re willing to wait out at sea, bring them offerings and get their favor. Even then, you may find yourself within the eye of a hurricane. This compass gives you a sense of calm and relief when you touch it, like a favorable wind has finally arrived.

Armor You gain a +1 item bonus to piloting checks for water- based vehicles.

Weapon The weapon has the underwater rune while the compass is affixed.

Activate Cast a Spell; Effect You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.tXa5vOu5giBNCjdR]{Know the Way}. In addition to the effects of the cantrip, the compass itself points in the general direction of a sea dragon for 1 minute, with the point glowing brighter as you get closer. Aligning the compass with the constellation of the Sea Dragon at night instead creates a beam for 1 minute to find Luong Phung again.

Cocoon.name: Cocoon
Cocoon.description:
Requirements You’re channeling your dragon.

You call upon the power of your forest dragon to protect an ally. Touch a willing creature to envelop them in a cocoon with 10 Hardness, 40 Hit Points, and the wood trait. The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned} for 1 round during which time all attacks that hit them damage the cocoon first. If the cocoon survives for 1 round, it dissolves and heals its occupant. The target regains @Damage[50[healing]] Hit Points and gains fast healing 5 until channel imperial dragon ends.

Rhythm of a Thousand Souls.name: Rhythm of a Thousand Souls
Rhythm of a Thousand Souls.description:
Requirements You are under the effects of Chun Jo Do.

Insight and adrenaline reveal the connectivity of all things, both within your inner song and in the rhythms of your enemy. Choose a creature you can see and roll a d20. The next time before the beginning of your next turn you Strike the chosen creature or attempt a saving throw against an effect it created, you can use the result for your roll instead of rolling. You cannot make a Strike against the creature until the beginning of your next turn unless you use your result.

Mole Mine (Major).name: Mole Mine (Major)
Mole Mine (Major).description:
Activate 1 (Manipulate)

This device looks like a very large mole but is a magical wooden construct. It must be placed on soil or ground when Activated, whereupon it burrows just under the surface of the ground 30 feet in a direction of your choice and ends its movement in a single 5-foot square, leaving no tunnels or signs of its passing. For up to 1 minute, if a creature moves on the ground within 5- foot emanation of the mole mine, it immediately resurfaces near the creature and explodes, dealing @Damage[3d6[fire],3[persistent,fire]]damage (@Check[reflex|dc:28|basic]) to all creatures in a 5-foot burst centered on the corner of the creature closest to the bomb that moved through the area.

Darting Speed.name: Darting Speed
Darting Speed.description:
Access access to training from a biaoshi ranger

“Biao" is a Tian-Shu word with many meanings depending on how it compounds other words. It can relate to the duties of a bodyguard, expressive forms of art, keeping to a deadline, as well as the gleaming of knives and darts. Darts and knives you wield with the agile and thrown traits also have reload 0. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks and DCs to hide or conceal these weapons or a +4 circumstance bonus if the weapon has the concealable trait.

Moss Cover (Moderate).name: Moss Cover (Moderate)
Moss Cover (Moderate).description:
Activate 1 (Manipulate)

The moss mixed in this vial of oil is a hardy and fast-growing specimen taken from Arindham’s body. Applying this oil to yourself grants you 20 temporary Hit Points for 8 hours due to the moss cover on your body protecting you. The moss regrows if you don’t lose all temporary Hit Points, causing you to regain the original number of temporary Hit Points granted by applying the oil. This effect occurs one hour after you last took damage while the oil lasts.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.misc.Item.O0JbtwMUMSSNVzoz]{Effect: Moss Cover (Moderate)}

I Can Do It!.name: I Can Do It!
I Can Do It!.description: Channeling your belief in yourself, you transform into a variant sentinel form that's perfect for the task ahead of you. Choose a skill. Your appearance changes to match a profession related to the skill you chose (such as a chef if you were Crafting food or a doctor if you chose Medicine). You become master in the skill you chose for 10 minutes, but you take a –2 penalty to checks not related to the skill you chose until the duration expires or you Dismiss the effect.

Sweeping Dance.name: Sweeping Dance
Sweeping Dance.description:
Trigger Your turn would end.

Requirements You're in karenza stance and would deal damage to adjacent enemies from using Perform.

Your swings have become wider and more deadly. You Step. You apply the damage from the Perform of your karenza dance to enemies adjacent to you before and after your Step.

Above the Fray.name: Above the Fray
Above the Fray.description:
Requirements You’re channeling your dragon.

As a representative of a sovereign dragon, you’re really too important to be dragged into the petty affairs of combat. You create an aura in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30] that lasts until while you’re channeling your dragon. Creatures within the aura take a –2 status penalty to attack rolls against you. You gain the Kneel Before the Sovereign reaction for the duration of this effect.

Together as One.name: Together as One
Together as One.description:
Trigger Your turn begins.

Your movements guide your allies, leading them in an inspiring rhythmic display of flourishes and agility. For 1 minute, when you Perform you grant allies within 30 feet of you the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition until the beginning of your next turn. Your allies can use this additional action only to Perform, Step, or Stride, but the allies lose the quickened condition if they ever move beyond 30 feet of you.

prerequisites.value: Karenza Bladedancer Dedication or Maglalatik Dancer Dedication

Obake Obstinance.name: Obake Obstinance
Obake Obstinance.description: You scare people for fun, making it harder for fear to affect you. At the end of your turn, if you would reduce a frightened condition by 1, you reduce it by 2 instead.

Power Up! Zodiac Form.name: Power Up! Zodiac Form
Power Up! Zodiac Form.description: You can channel your zodiac aspects into a powerful spiritual form. Choose a battleform spell related to your zodiac such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.wp09USMB3GIW1qbp]{Animal Form}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.E3zIZ4pjlOuWeGRz]{Angel Form}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.dR53f0p15EW7D0xC]{Devil Form}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.5c692cCcTDXjSEzk]{Dragon Form}. You can cast this spell as an arcane innate spell once per day with a rank heightened to half your level rounded up.

Divine Devotion.name: Divine Devotion
Divine Devotion.description: You can draw upon your sky dragon’s devotion to a deity to empower your own faith. While you are channeling your dragon, you gain the holy trait as well as your Strikes and spells.

prerequisites.value: follower of a specific religion or philosophy that can sanctify devoted followers

Share Anguish.name: Share Anguish
Share Anguish.description:
Requirements You’re channeling your sea dragon.

Sometimes peace only comes when two sides feel each other’s pain, and sharing in that pain can bring two opposing forces to a new horizons. You pull all the power you can channel from your dragon at once, Dismissing channel imperial dragon to create an area of shared empathy in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:100] around you for 5 rounds. If a creature damages another creature inside the aura, they take mental damage equal to the amount they dealt with a @Check[will|against:class-spell|basic] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. Regardless of the result, the creature is then temporarily immune to Share Anguish for 1 day.

Reach Through Air.name: Reach Through Air
Reach Through Air.description:
You learn to project qi energy beyond your body, extending your attacks. Make a melee Strike, increasing your reach by 5 feet for that Strike. If the unarmed attack or weapon has the disarm, shove, or trip traits, you can use the corresponding action instead of a Strike.

Energize Increase the reach by 15 feet instead of 5.

Talbeng Transformation.name: Talbeng Transformation
Talbeng Transformation.description: You perform a dance that mimics the movements of animals of Minata, allowing you to manifest their form. Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.wp09USMB3GIW1qbp]{Animal Form} as a divine innate spell of a rank heightened to half your level rounded up.

prerequisites.value: Karenza Bladedancer Dedication or Maglalatik Dancer Dedication

Moss Cover (Major).name: Moss Cover (Major)
Moss Cover (Major).description:
Activate 1 (Manipulate)

The moss mixed in this vial of oil is a hardy and fast-growing specimen taken from Arindham’s body. Applying this oil to yourself grants you 50 temporary Hit Points for 24 hours due to the moss cover on your body protecting you. The moss regrows if you don’t lose all temporary Hit Points, causing you to regain the original number of temporary Hit Points granted by applying the oil. This effect occurs one hour after you last took damage while the oil lasts.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.misc.Item.hGr1qCc4p3W64f6L]{Effect: Moss Cover (Major)}

Form of the Imperial.name: Form of the Imperial
Form of the Imperial.description: You have learned to take the form of your dragon. If your next action is to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.player-options.V3GVl8DGAwp8HvOK]{Channel Imperial Dragon}, you also gain the effects of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.5c692cCcTDXjSEzk]{Dragon Form} heightened to a rank equal to half your level rounded up. You must select your imperial dragon for your battle form. You can use actions and activities you gained from this archetype while you are in this battleform.

Chatterteeth Pearls.name: Chatterteeth Pearls
Chatterteeth Pearls.description:
Chatterteeth pearls are irregularly shaped and appear to be low quality, worth very little as jewelry, but they come from rare Gray Gulf oysters where ashfall from Valashai ruins magically twists much of the wildlife. Pearls from the same chatterteeth oyster are magically linked, enabling telepathic communication. These pearls come as a set of jewelry—one piece is an earring while the other is a necklace. The earring is a gaudy piece wrought in gold that doesn’t appear to be worth more than 20 gp while the necklace is a string just long enough to wrap around the neck once or the wrist twice and doesn’t appear to be worth more than 50 gp. Neither piece has any magical effect until both are invested by different people. Each wearer can Activate their piece once a day.

Activate—Send Message 3 Cast a Spell; Frequency once per day

Effect You cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.R9xqCBblkS5KE4y7]{Sending} spell with the wearer of the other pair of jewelry as the target.

Unleash Fragment.name: Unleash Fragment
Unleash Fragment.description: Your mastery of kaijus is such that you can evoke their greatest battles to aid you, using the fragments of their power instilled in you to call upon them. Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.WRP8TDf36hqHyGv1]{Summon Kaiju} as a primal innate spell.

Fury of a Thousand.name: Fury of a Thousand
Fury of a Thousand.description:
The cadence of the flock harmonizes with your song. Depending on your selection from Birds of a Feather, the new chords either bolster their audience or become a painful cacophony. If your next action is to cast either @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Xxdwkt0EEDgP1LGc]{Song of Strength} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.4EmLum6EdvXxbxCj]{Murmuration}, your spell gains the following effects in addition to its normal effects.

Murmuration You deal both types of damage instead of piercing or sonic, and on a critical failure the status penalty is –3 instead of –2.

Song of Strength The status bonus increases to +2.

Geojibom's Greatpick (True).name: Geojibom's Greatpick (True)
Geojibom's Greatpick (True).description:
This pitch black +3 major striking greater flaming greater impactful high-grade adamantine greatpick is made from alloys of reinforced metals forged by Geojibom’s breath. On a critical hit, the force of the greatpick’s impact unleashes a fiery explosion that deals @Damage[6d6[fire]] damage to all creatures within 10 feet of your target except for yourself with a @Check[reflex|dc:43|basic] save. Creatures who critically fail their save are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled}for 1 round.

Activate—Cast a Spell

Effect You cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.vJZ83ehQiM906lea]{Detect Metal} cantrip. In addition to metal, you are also aware of gemstones and other precious materials that are naturally occurring in earth and would be considered valuable treasure by an underworld dragon.

Golden Core.name: Golden Core
Golden Core.description:
You've condensed your qi into a solid core of refined energy, greatly improving its cultivation. Your proficiency ranks for spell attack modifier and spell DC increase to expert, and whenever you Refocus, you recover 2 Focus Points instead of 1.

At 18th level, your proficiency ranks for spell attack modifier and spell DC increase to master, and whenever you Refocus, completely refill your focus pool.

prerequisites.value: at least one focus spell from the cultivator archetype

Bird's Eye View.name: Bird's Eye View
Bird's Eye View.description: You call upon the flock to share its knowledge to you. You gain the swarm mind ability for the duration. In addition, you can use Religion instead of the normal skill for all Recall Knowledge checks for the duration and you treat your degree of success as one better when you do.

Frighten Prey.name: Frighten Prey
Frighten Prey.description:
All living creatures have been hunted at some point in history, a memory of that fear lingers in even the greatest predators. Choose a creature within 30 feet that you could Recall Knowledge on using Nature or Society. You gain the effects of a successful Recall Knowledge on the creature and also learn of one of its predators. Your kami then assists you by manifesting a spectral image of the predator that lasts for 1 round. Appropriate creatures within 30 feet that can see the spectral image must attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. Regardless of your result, targets are temporarily immune to Frighten Prey for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing}.

Conduct Combat.name: Conduct Combat
Conduct Combat.description: You use your spirit performers in a moment of duress, expediting their song and its effects. Choose a tang mai orchestration that you know. You create a @Template[type:burst|distance:20] of spirit performers that grant the effects of that orchestration to all allies within the area, as if you had prepared the orchestration. You cannot summon your spirit performers again for 1 hour, even if you had prepared another tang mai orchestration.

Qi Shaper Dedication.name: Qi Shaper Dedication
Qi Shaper Dedication.description:
Access Chu Ye origin or access to training from a qi practitioner

You know how to harness the life energy inside you to push your limits in combat. As befits practices that survived decades of oppression in Chu Ye, your control of qi is less the flowing, practiced form of monks and more bursts of energy to swing fights in your favor or end them quickly.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.misc.38Ks1K36sOWumo2f]{Qi-Empowered Blows} qi-shape action. You gain a Focus Pool if you did not already have one with a Focus Point of 1, or increase the number of Focus Points in your Focus Pool by 1.

Enchanter's Dance.name: Enchanter's Dance
Enchanter's Dance.description:
Requirements You’re in dance of the kaiju caller stance.

You have altered your dance to counteract attacks on the mind. While in dance of the kaiju caller stance, you apply your circumstance bonus to AC from cover to saves against mental effects from Large or larger creatures.

Hongali Weapon Familiarity.name: Hongali Weapon Familiarity
Hongali Weapon Familiarity.description:
Since you were a child, you were trained with the traditional hongali weapons, including the famed hongali hornbow. When you are wielding a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.rQWaJhI5Bko5x14Z]{Dagger}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.aXuJh4i8HqSu6NYV]{Longspear}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.tOhoGvmCMw4JpWcS]{Spear}, increase its damage die size by one step. You have familiarity with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.War0uyLBx1jA0Ge7]{Battle Axe}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.e4NwsnPnpQKbDZ9F]{Composite Shortbow}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.a5DlDpB3RuSIvLIC]{Hongali Hornbow}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.hIgqLgH3YcLZBeoT]{Shortbow}—for the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.

Grasping Flames.name: Grasping Flames
Grasping Flames.description:
Like a snake striking at injured prey, your connection to an underworld dragon makes you particularly adept at exploiting the weaknesses of a burned creature.

While you’re channeling your dragon, your body is burning hot. A creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} by you takes @Damage[@actor.level[fire]] damage equal to your level at the end of its turn with a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|basic] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. On a critical failure, the target also takes @Damage[(floor(@actor.level/2))[persistent,fire]] damage equal to half your level. In addition, when you attempt to Grapple a creature suffering from persistent fire damage, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Athletics check.

Remonstrative Rhetoric.name: Remonstrative Rhetoric
Remonstrative Rhetoric.description:
Your command of metaphors, stentorian speech, and imposing body language allow you to make dramatic condemnations. You can inspire dread and shame without resorting to brute force or breaking decorum; your reputation remains irreproachable, and none can gainsay you without appearing churlish or admitting complicity.

You can use Society to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.tHCqgwjtQtzNqVvd]{Coerce} instead of Intimidation by using the language of your authority in your speech and you can compare your Society check result to the Will DCs of up to 10 targets you gave your speech, with no penalty. The number of targets increases to 20 if you’re an expert, 50 if you’re a master, and 100 if you’re legendary.

If you successfully Coerce using Society, your speech is circuitous enough to avoid giving offence, as well as sufficiently eloquent to provoke your audience into revealing a glimpse into their emotions. The targets you successfully Coerce can choose either to become unfriendly as usual, or retain their original attitude towards you if that is indifferent or better. If they become unfriendly, you instantly become aware of their attitude shift, and can immediately make the creatures or their unrest one of your leads.

Calm in the Storm.name: Calm in the Storm
Calm in the Storm.description: Even during a disaster, you are able to keep a level head in any situation. You gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws against mental effects. When you have less than half your total Hit Points or are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened}, this status bonus increases to +2.

prerequisites.value: At least three feats from the Nagajor Monsoon Expert archetype

Terminal Lucidity.name: Terminal Lucidity
Terminal Lucidity.description:
Trigger You would gain the dying condition.

Your intense training allows you to keep your life’s flame burning with even the smallest embers. You remain conscious even though you are dying, though all the other rules for the dying condition still apply. At the start of each turn that you are conscious when dying, you gain the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.misc.38Ks1K36sOWumo2f]{Qi-Empowered Blows} as if you had reduced your Hit Points by the maximum amount. If you make a successful Strike with a Qi-Empowered Blow, you lose the dying condition and restore a number of Hit Points equal to the additional damage you dealt with your Strike. You do not increase your wounded value if you recover from the dying condition in this way.

What Goes Around.name: What Goes Around
What Goes Around.description:
Trigger A creature that is flanking you attempts a melee Strike against you.

You take the energy from your opponent’s attack and redirect it at another foe. Make a Strike against the triggering creature. If your Strike is successful, the target does not provide flanking for its allies and does not treat you as off-guard due to flanking until the beginning of your next turn.

Energize If your Strike is successful, you move the target up to 5 feet into another space. It must remain within your reach during this movement. If the target enters the space of an obstacle or creature, it falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} in that space. If your Strike was a critical success, you can move the target up to 10 feet.

Chun Jo Do.name: Chun Jo Do
Chun Jo Do.description:
You are among the latest in countless generations of the monastic-knights which have served the Joyaga since its construction. You contemplate often on a single teaching of Phi Deva, letting it guide you in service to the community. Choose one of the following options when you first gain this feat, gaining the ability to channel it through your body. When you use this action, you gain the effects of your choice for 1 minute.

Kyung Seong You move with an untethered grace, as a bird in flight. You gain a +10-foot status bonus to your Speeds. If you are at least 13th level, you gain the effects of fly in addition to the normal effects.

Jung Seong You move with a belligerent appreciation for the world, firmly rooting yourself in the moment. You gain a +1 status bonus to Grapple checks and to Fortitude saves against forced movement and effects that would give you the prone condition. If you are at least 13th level, the status bonus increases to +2.

Chyel Seong Your limbs become as radiant as steel, guided by divine murmuration to your defense. Your fist gains the parry trait and you gain the effects of parry when you use this action. Once while the effect is active and you are benefiting from a parry circumstance bonus, you can spend your reaction to reduce the damage by your level. If you are at least 13th level, the circumstance bonus of your fist’s parry is +2 instead of +1.

Ma Seong Your body becomes numb to pain and joy alike, your devotion endures while your body fails. You gain resistance to precision damage and critical hits equal to your level. If you are at least 13th level, the resistance is equal to twice your level instead of your level.

Shin Seong Your mind becomes awash with sublime vigilance, granting you composure in dire circumstances. You gain a +1 status bonus against emotion effects and at the end of your turn, reduce your frightened condition by 2 instead of 1. If you are at least 13th level, the status bonus increases to +2 and anytime you gain the frightened condition, reduce its value by 1.

Special You can select this feat multiple times, each time gaining access to a new effect you can use for Chun Jo Do.

Kaiju's Size.name: Kaiju's Size
Kaiju's Size.description: Your eidolon takes on the impossible dimensions of a kaiju. It becomes Gargantuan, instead of its previous size, and the reach on all its attacks increases to 20 feet. As an action, it may change its size to Medium, or to any other size available to it through an evolution feat, reducing its reach according to its new size.

Dance Upon the Soaring Blade.name: Dance Upon the Soaring Blade
Dance Upon the Soaring Blade.description:
You link your weapon to your mind and spirit, letting you wield it with your very soul. During your daily preparations, you can select a single weapon you hold and grant it the animated property rune, which doesn’t count toward your maximum limit of runes. When your weapon is Set Free, you can use your attack roll modifier or your spell attack modifier for the purposes of its Strikes, whichever is higher.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.misc.8c03Bfb294ruMcBy]{Effect: Dance Upon the Soaring Blade (Animated Rune)}

When you use the Set Free activity, you can choose to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap} onto your weapon as part of the activity if it is within 5 feet of you. While you remain on your weapon, you gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed. The weapon can’t make Strikes or otherwise act while you are using it to Fly, and your Fly actions gain the concentrate trait as you mentally command it to move. You do not need to make a flat check at the end of each turn while using your animated weapon to Fly, but you must use the Fly action each turn or the weapon falls to the ground and can't be Set Free again for 10 minutes.

Stone Pathways.name: Stone Pathways
Stone Pathways.description: You have earned your underworld dragon’s trust enough for them to reveal their secrets for quickly traversing the Darklands. You can cast 6th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.F1qxaqsEItmBura2]{Nature's Pathway} as an arcane innate spell once per day, but instead of living trees, you can use any stone bonsai or any other stone trees carved by your underworld dragon. At 18th level, nature’s pathway is heightened to 8th rank; at 20th level, it’s heightened to 9th rank.

Scales of Thorn and Spore.name: Scales of Thorn and Spore
Scales of Thorn and Spore.description:
Trigger You are hit with a melee Strike.

Requirements You're channeling your dragon.

When attacked while channeling a forest dragon your body erupts in razor thorns and ancient mushrooms born from a memory of a primordial forest floor. The creature takes @Damage[(4+max(0,(ceil((@actor.level -17)/4))))d4[piercing],(4+max(0,(ceil((@actor.level -17)/4))))d4[poison]] poison damage with a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|basic] save. Creatures that fail their save are also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} or are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure. At 18th level, the piercing damage and poison damage each increase by 1d4.

Effortless Qi.name: Effortless Qi
Effortless Qi.description:
Trigger You would reduce your Hit Points from using Qi-Empowered Blow for the maximum amount.

Your qi flows effortlessly through your body for an attack. You do not reduce your Hit Points by the triggering amount.

Imperial Aura.name: Imperial Aura
Imperial Aura.description: You gain a 5-foot aura with the elemental trait of your channel while you’re channeling your imperial dragon. Allies within the area gain the resistances and status bonus granted to you from channel imperial dragon. Enemies that end their turn within the area must attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save, and on a failure they gain a weakness to the damage type of your imperial dragon equal to half your level and a –1 status penalty against mental effects. These effects last for as long as they remain in the area and for 1 round after they leave the area, or for 4 rounds after they leave the area if they got a critical failure on their Will save. You can choose to expand the radius of your aura by 5 feet when you Sustain channel imperial dragon. This effect gains the tradition associated with your dragon.

Tang Mai Conductor Dedication.name: Tang Mai Conductor Dedication
Tang Mai Conductor Dedication.description:
Access Tian Xia origin

You’ve been taught by another Tang Mai Conductor. Their skills and knowledge have been passed down to you. You become trained in Tang Mai Lore. You become an expert in Performance and also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.xqAdXRd2gSQcqp5E]{Impressive Performance} feat. You gain access to tang mai orchestrations, powerful magic songs you can learn and conduct in an activity that takes 1 hour to perform. You learn a common or uncommon orchestration of your level or lower (or another orchestration to which you have access). At 6th level and every 4 levels thereafter, you learn an additional tang mai orchestration.

After you have spent 1 hour preparing a tang mai orchestration, you can spend a single action with the concentrate trait to call upon your spirit performers to appear in a @Template[type:burst|distance:20] within 30 feet of you. These performers grant the effects of your tang mai orchestration to all allies in the area for 1 minute. You cannot call on your spirit performers again unless you prepare another orchestration.

Pierce Three Hearts.name: Pierce Three Hearts
Pierce Three Hearts.description:
Requirements You are mounted.

You hang off the side of your galloping mount, shooting at the enemies passing by with uncanny precision. Command your mount to Stride once and make three ranged Strikes with a bow at any point during this Stride, each against a separate target and with a –2 penalty. All three attacks count toward your multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn’t increase until after you’ve made all of them.

Birds of a Feather.name: Birds of a Feather
Birds of a Feather.description: You’ve trained with the sparrows for so long that innately, you’ve joined their flock. Choose either the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Xxdwkt0EEDgP1LGc]{Song of Strength} composition cantrip or the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.4EmLum6EdvXxbxCj]{Murmuration} hex cantrip. You gain the chosen spell as a divine composition cantrip or a divine hex cantrip respectively. Once this choice is made it cannot be changed.

Redirect Wrath.name: Redirect Wrath
Redirect Wrath.description: When the great and mighty are roused to unquenchable rage, when one must suffer their tempestuous wrath, it is best that wrath fall upon one capable of surviving it. While in your dance of the kaiju caller stance, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.misc.ezCLXmuQzP9v15jB]{Attract Wrath} reaction.

Tinikling Flurry.name: Tinikling Flurry
Tinikling Flurry.description:
Requirements You're in a Minatan dancer stance.

Your movements invoke your guiding spirit to sprout tinikling sticks from the ground. These pieces of bamboo snap together, snapping the ankles of those less dexterous than the humble tikling bird. You Perform, causing all creatures touching the ground within a @Template[type:line|distance:30] to take @Damage[(10+max(0,(ceil((@actor.level -11)/2)*2)))d6[bludgeoning]] damage with a @Check[type:reflex|dc:resolve(@actor.attributes.classDC.value)|basic] save against your class DC. Creatures that fail their save take a –10-foot status penalty to its Speeds for 1 round, or for 1 minute on a critical failure. At 12th level and every 2 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 2d6.

Ballad of Strength.name: Ballad of Strength
Ballad of Strength.description:
Your orchestra plays a song that inspires strength and might.

Expert Allies who heard the song gain a +1 status bonus to their melee attack rolls.

Master As expert, except the status bonus is +2.

Legendary As expert, except the status bonus is +3.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.misc.Item.MEtXxFfLcE1us4hh]{Effect: Ballad of Strength}

Forced Maneuver.name: Forced Maneuver
Forced Maneuver.description:
Requirements You are wielding at least one sai.

Your disarming movements become more fluid, allowing you greater control over your foes. When you successfully @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} a creature using a sai you are wielding, you can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition} them by spending your reaction. Both attacks count toward your multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn’t increase until after you’ve made both of them.

Moss Cover (Lesser).name: Moss Cover (Lesser)
Moss Cover (Lesser).description:
Activate 1 (Manipulate)

The moss mixed in this vial of oil is a hardy and fast-growing specimen taken from Arindham’s body. Applying this oil to yourself grants you 10 temporary Hit Points for 4 hours due to the moss cover on your body protecting you. The moss regrows if you don’t lose all temporary Hit Points, causing you to regain the original number of temporary Hit Points granted by applying the oil. This effect occurs one hour after you last took damage while the oil lasts.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.misc.pgNK7bqLYJbCPVit]{Effect: Moss Cover}

Phial of Zhulong (Moderate).name: Phial of Zhulong (Moderate)
Phial of Zhulong (Moderate).description:
Activate A Strike

This sphere of glass is filled with two separate liquids, a sickly yellow oil and the lurid green distilled saliva of an underworld dragon. It explodes into acrid sparks when shaken and thrown. Developed by the young underworld dragon Zhulong in their plan to siege the kishin oni Inma’s fortress, it is more damaging to objects than creatures. A phial of Zhulong deals the 1d8 acid damage and 2d4 persistent acid damage, but it deals double damage to inanimate objects that are not being held. Inanimate mundane objects that receive double damage also have their Hardness permanently reduced by 1 each time they are hit—if their Hardness would be reduced to less than 0, they gain a weakness to acid and fire damage equal to 1 or increase these values by 1 if they already had a weakness. Flammable objects within 5 feet of the bomb’s target immediately catch on fire, taking 1d4 fire damage each round until extinguished, regardless of the outcome of the bomb’s attack roll. Many types grant an item bonus to attack rolls.

Fireworks Boots.name: Fireworks Boots
Fireworks Boots.description:
These boots were smithed from a hardened dragonscale that has been hammered to look like solid bronze. The scales never dull, no matter how often the boots are worn. You gain a +5-foot item bonus to the maximum distance of all Leaps.

Activate—Sparkstep 2 (manipulate) Frequency once per day

Effect You Stride. Every step causes the ground to quake, and creatures within 5 feet of each space you move through must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:20] save. They become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 round on a failure, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} on a critical failure.

Arindham's Whip (Major).name: Arindham's Whip (Major)
Arindham's Whip (Major).description:
This leathery, moss-covered +3 greater striking rooting whip is made from a petrified lizardfolk’s tongue, gnarled peachwood and Arindham’s whiskers. Foes who are bioengineered, artificial, or corrupted in some way, including but not limited to creatures with the aberration, construct, and undead traits, are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to you while they are immobilized by the whip’s rooting rune. You can use the following action when holding the whip.

Activate—Crack of the Vine 1 (manipulate) Frequency once per hour

Effect For 1 round, razor-sharp thorns cover Arindham’s whip—it loses the nonlethal trait and attacks also deal @Damage[4d4[bleed]] damage.

A Thousand Voices Coalesce.name: A Thousand Voices Coalesce
A Thousand Voices Coalesce.description: You have magnified your voice by a thousand. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.player-options.P7KngKXlXnjHavc9]{Chorus Made Manifest} focus spell.

Lessons on Communication.name: Lessons on Communication
Lessons on Communication.description: Your kami assists you in communicating with plants and animals. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.BBvV7qoXGdw09q1C]{Speak with Animals} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.qvwIwJ9QBihy8R0t]{Speak with Plants} as primal innate spells, each once per day. When you Cast the Spell, your kami assists you for as long as the spells remain in effect and you gain a +2 status bonus to Diplomacy and Intimidation checks against animals and plants.

Adorable Sidekick.name: Adorable Sidekick
Adorable Sidekick.description: Perhaps sent from the constellations above, a familiar has come to guide you! You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.6yPrvbSDaa8glLjn]{Pet} feat. When you are not in sentinel form, your pet resembles a mundane animal, and can only use abilities from the Pet feat, though it always shares one language with you. Choose two familiar abilities each day during your daily preparations. When you’re in your sentinel form, your pet transforms into a magical familiar and its appearance changes drastically. It gains the familiar abilities you selected during your daily preparations while you’re in sentinel form in addition to the abilities it gained from being your pet. You can choose to make your sidekick’s familiar form a specific familiar, provided you have enough familiar abilities to select it. If you select a specific familiar for your sidekick’s familiar form, the choice becomes permanent unless you spend 1 week of downtime to change it. Your sidekick has the arcane trait in addition to any traits it would normally have and can be used as your transformation seal.

Bend the Spirit.name: Bend the Spirit
Bend the Spirit.description: You have learned to leverage different energy from your life force. You can alter the spirit damage from your Qi-Empowered Blows to be force, vitality, or void damage. You must choose the damage type at the time you use Qi-Empowered Blows.

Fog of the Imperial.name: Fog of the Imperial
Fog of the Imperial.description:
Requirements You’re channeling your dragon.

You create a magical fog to hide you and your allies. Dense magical fog surrounds you in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] that lasts as long as you are channeling your dragon, but you can Dismiss the fog at any time. All creatures within the area become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.tWS8aMCyeGKcnFh1]{Concealed}, and all creatures outside the area become concealed to creatures within it. When you Sustain channel imperial dragon, you can choose to increase the size of the emanation by 5 feet.

Maglalatik Dancer Dedication.name: Maglalatik Dancer Dedication
Maglalatik Dancer Dedication.description:
Access Minatan origin or familiar with minatan culture

The coconut is the prize of Minata and it cannot be won by the outlanders; the percussion is a mockery of their marching boots, despite Minata's wealth of resources, they did not need it to beat down their foes. You become trained in medium armor and you gain access to coconut shells and maglalatik armor. Whenever you gain a class feature that grants you expert or greater proficiency in any type of armor (but not unarmored defense), you also gain that proficiency in the armor types granted to you by this feat. You gain the Maglalatik Stance action.

prerequisites.value: trained in Performance and light armor

Verse of Rhythm.name: Verse of Rhythm
Verse of Rhythm.description:
You orchestrate a song with a robust and lingering rhythm, granting your allies swiftness. Your allies become quickened.

Expert Your allies are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened}. They can use the extra action to Step.

Master Your allies are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened}. They can use the extra action to Step or Stride.

Legendary Your allies are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened}. They can use the extra action to Step, Stride, or Strike.

Shei Long's Blade (Major).name: Shei Long's Blade (Major)
Shei Long's Blade (Major).description:
This +1 striking ghost touch katana is crafted from the bright jade ore that is the foundation of Zi Ha’s mountains. The blade is blessed by Tsukiyo’s moonlight, and its edge is infused with Shei Long’s tooth.

Activate—Judgement of the Sky r (manipulate, electricity) Trigger Your attack roll with Shei Long's blade is a critical sucess

Effect The judgment of the heavens flows from the blade. Your target takes @Damage[6d8[electricity]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}. All the target’s allies within 20 feet take @Damage[3d8[electricity]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:19|basic] Reflex save. Creatures who critically fail their save are slowed 1.

The Natural Order.name: The Natural Order
The Natural Order.description: There is a natural order of dominance in the jungle, and the meek don’t belong at the top. When you roll Intimidation for initiative, you gain a +2 status bonus to your initiative.

Vocal Mediation.name: Vocal Mediation
Vocal Mediation.description:
Your training has granted you greater control over your body’s natural functions, and you’re able to help yourself and allies recover in shorter stints using your inner song. You spend 10 minutes meditating while using your inner song through Performance, making a @Check[performance|dc:@self.level] check against a standard DC of your level.

Critical Success You and allies within 30 feet of you regain Hit Points equal to twice your level, lose the fatigued condition if they had it, and reduce the severity of the doomed and drained conditions by 2.

Success As success, except the Hit Points regained is equal to your level and they only reduce the severity of the doomed and drained conditions by 1.

Sweeping Tail.name: Sweeping Tail
Sweeping Tail.description: You make a wide arc with your interlocked hook swords. Make a melee Strike and compare the attack roll result to the AC of up to two foes. Each foe must be within your melee reach, and within 10 feet of each other. Roll damage only once and apply it to each creature you hit. This counts as two attacks for your multiple attack penalty.

Warrior's Dance.name: Warrior's Dance
Warrior's Dance.description: You have learned to endure the battle up close, even when under threat. Your dance of the kaiju caller stance does not end when a Large or larger creature critically succeeds its Strike against you. While in your dance of the kaiju caller stance, you apply your circumstance bonus to AC from cover to Fortitude saves against effects that would knock you prone or cause forced movement.

Line of Succession.name: Line of Succession
Line of Succession.description:
Trigger You would be reduced to 0 Hit Points.

Requirements You’re channeling your dragon with at least one ally you can see within 60 feet.

A good ruler always has a contingency plan. Choose an ally within 60 feet as being charged with preserving the line of succession. The ally gains a 40 temporary Hit Points, a +2 status bonus to AC and to skill checks for actions or activities that would bring it closer to you for 1 minute. The ally must spend at least 1 action on each of its turns to move towards you or Interact to touch you. When you ally uses an Interact action to touch and you immediately regain @Damage[20[healing]] Hit Points, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.OdIUybJ3ddfL7wzj]{Stand}, and begin @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.player-options.V3GVl8DGAwp8HvOK]{channeling your dragon}, using the remaining duration from channel imperial dragon from before you were reduced to 0 Hit Points. When you lose the dying condition this way, you don’t gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded 1} condition or increase your wounded value by 1 if you already have the condition. After your ally uses an Interact action to touch you, they no longer need to spend at least 1 action on each of their turns to move towards you or touch you.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.misc.F8WOIWRiYH5kDvKn]{Effect: Line of Succession}

Sky Dragon's Eyes (Greater).name: Sky Dragon's Eyes (Greater)
Sky Dragon's Eyes (Greater).description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

These pale cheese curd balls resemble the eyes of sky dragons and taste light and airy. After you eat this cheese curd, you gain a sky dragon’s mist vision for the listed duration—fog and mist don’t impair your vision; ignore the concealed condition from fog and mist for 24 hours.

Fortify Self.name: Fortify Self
Fortify Self.description:
You fortify yourself by creating an ephemeral shield of qi. This shield lasts until the start of your next turn. The first time you take physical damage while the shield is active, reduce the damage by your level

Energize The next time you take damage while the shield is active, you reduce the damage of the damaging effect by your level. If this effect would reduce the damage to 0 and the damage came from an attack, the attack counts as a miss instead of a hit.

Body of the Kami Dedication.name: Body of the Kami Dedication
Body of the Kami Dedication.description:
A kami is tied to your soul and protects you while guiding you to serve a possible destiny. You become trained in Nature or an expert in Nature if you were already trained. You are bound to a kami which advises you on your journey, changing its demeanor towards you based on your actions.

Edicts defend nature and wilderness, protect the innocent, oppose greed and the exploitation of the natural world

Anathema covet physical indulgences, seek power within the governance of civilization

If you perform enough acts that are anathema to your kami, you lose the magical abilities and any actions you gained from this archetype. These abilities can be regained only if you repent by conducting an atone ritual. You gain your choice of one of the following free actions, which manifest by your kami providing you assistance.

After you use an action or activity you gained from this archetype, your kami’s energy is depleted and it cannot assist you again for 1 hour.

prerequisites.value: You risked death to defend nature in the Forest of Spirits or a location where kami are present.

Skirmisher's Dance.name: Skirmisher's Dance
Skirmisher's Dance.description:
Requirements You’re in dance of the kaiju caller stance and are benefitting from standard or greater cover and are capable of making a range Strike.

Your ranged attacks from cover against large enemies allow you to remain vigilant and hidden. Make a range Strike against a Large or larger enemy you have cover from and then immediately @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover}. The Strike gains the following failure effect.

Failure If you were unnoticed, undetected, or hidden before your Strike, you remain undetected if you were unnoticed or undetected, and you remain hidden if you were hidden.

Song of Silhouettes.name: Song of Silhouettes
Song of Silhouettes.description:
Your orchestra plays the music common in puppet theater, transforming your spirit performers into either Lantern Wisps, Makhluk Wayang, or Shikigami (Tian Xia Character Guide p. 125). Each ally in the area gains a familiar for the duration. These familiars have a number of abilities depending on the DC of the check, but cannot select abilities that would only be usable once per day or that would require a physical form. Your allies’ familiars use your level to determine any effects that would be based on level and what abilities can be selected. For the purposes of selecting abilities, such as darkeater, these familiars are treated as shadow familiars.

Expert The familiars have 2 familiar abilities.

Master The familiars have 3 familiar abilities.

Legendary The familiars have 4 familiar abilities.

Dance of the Serpent.name: Dance of the Serpent
Dance of the Serpent.description:
Requirements You have a tang mai orchestration currently in effect.

You have learned the dance of the serpent, a technique of weaving conducted songs into multiple movements in a short time. You choose another orchestration you know and alter the effects of the required orchestration to the chosen orchestration. Allies in the area gain the effects of the new orchestration instead of the original.

Mole Mine (Lesser).name: Mole Mine (Lesser)
Mole Mine (Lesser).description:
Activate 1 (Manipulate)

This device looks like a very large mole but is a magical wooden construct. It must be placed on soil or ground when Activated, whereupon it burrows just under the surface of the ground 30 feet in a direction of your choice and ends its movement in a single 5-foot square, leaving no tunnels or signs of its passing. For up to 1 minute, if a creature moves on the ground within 5- foot emanation of the mole mine, it immediately resurfaces near the creature and explodes, dealing @Damage[1d6[fire],1[persistent,fire]]damage (@Check[reflex|dc:15|basic]) to all creatures in a 5-foot burst centered on the corner of the creature closest to the bomb that moved through the area.

Inspire Subject.name: Inspire Subject
Inspire Subject.description: You know how to inspire subjects of the sovereign to perform important tasks. During your daily preparations, you can choose a willing ally to become your sovereign protector. While you’re channeling your dragon, your ally gains a +1 status bonus to checks to perform actions or activities that would protect you from harm (subject to GM discretion). These actions must usually be directly related to protecting you, such as getting closer to you, preventing damage, or stopping hostile actions against you.

Luong Phung's Trident (True).name: Luong Phung's Trident (True)
Luong Phung's Trident (True).description:
This elegant steel +3 major striking returning trident is coated with scales that Luong Phung has shed throughout the years. The shaft is cool and soothing to touch, like gentle waves gliding over your hand.

Activate—Ring Tines 2 (manipulate, sonic) Frequency once per day

Effect Each creature within 15 feet takes @Damage[10d10[sonic]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:43|basic] save). Any creature that fails is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 round, or 1 hour on a critical failure.

Pham Lê Ngọc's Ceremonial Sword (Greater.name: Pham Lê Ngọc's Ceremonial Sword (Greater)
Pham Lê Ngọc's Ceremonial Sword (Greater.description:
This +2 striking astral shifting low-grade cold iron liuyedao comes in an intricately ornamented scabbard covered with designs of imperial dragons. In addition to its ability to shift into different weapon types, the blade and scabbard can transform their appearance to pass as official ceremonial swords of any nation the wielder has seen, granting a +2 item bonus to Deception checks to pass as a diplomat of that nation. The blade may also be allowed in areas where weapons are otherwise banned, at the GM’s discretion, due to its function as a diplomatic status symbol.
