Activate—Focused Attack 2 (concentrate, flourish, manipulate) Requirements You haven't attacked your target today

Effect You have one chance to take out a target. Make a Strike. Your outcome is one degree of success better than what you rolled. If the outcome was already a critical success, your target takes an additional @Damage[4d6[precision]]{2d6 precision} damage.

Geojibom's Greatpick (Major).name: Geojibom's Greatpick (Major)
Geojibom's Greatpick (Major).description:
This pitch black +2 greater striking flaming greatpick is made from alloys of reinforced metals forged by Geojibom’s breath. On a critical hit, the force of the greatpick’s impact unleashes a fiery explosion that deals @Damage[4d6[fire]] damage to all creatures within 10 feet of your target except for yourself with a @Check[reflex|dc:31|basic] save. Creatures who critically fail their save are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled}for 1 round.

Activate—Cast a Spell

Effect You cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.vJZ83ehQiM906lea]{Detect Metal} cantrip. In addition to metal, you are also aware of gemstones and other precious materials that are naturally occurring in earth and would be considered valuable treasure by an underworld dragon.

Grand Quartermaster.name: Grand Quartermaster
Grand Quartermaster.description: An army is nothing without its camp. You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.vPWMEyVTreMOoFnm]{Planar Palace} as a divine innate spell. The palace always appears as a large army camp in any layout you choose and the servants appear as other terra-cotta automatons. An illusion of the sky is visible within the camp, and it takes on any appearance you choose. The entrance cannot be made invisible, but it can be disguised to appear as a 10-foot square tent.

Collateral Carnage.name: Collateral Carnage
Collateral Carnage.description: Your Eidolon’s size and ferocity intensifies, making it deadly to even those near its targets. Your eidolon’s primary attacks gain the sweep trait. When your eidolon critically succeeds at a Strike with its primary attack, choose one creature adjacent to the initial target and within reach. If its AC is lower than your attack roll result for the critical hit, you deal damage to that creature equal to the result of the damage die you rolled (including extra dice for its striking rune, if any). This amount isn't doubled, and no bonuses or other additional dice apply to this damage.

Phial of Zhulong (Greater).name: Phial of Zhulong (Greater)
Phial of Zhulong (Greater).description:
Activate A Strike

This sphere of glass is filled with two separate liquids, a sickly yellow oil and the lurid green distilled saliva of an underworld dragon. It explodes into acrid sparks when shaken and thrown. Developed by the young underworld dragon Zhulong in their plan to siege the kishin oni Inma’s fortress, it is more damaging to objects than creatures. A phial of Zhulong deals the 2d8 acid damage and 3d4 persistent acid damage, but it deals double damage to inanimate objects that are not being held. Inanimate mundane objects that receive double damage also have their Hardness permanently reduced by 1 each time they are hit—if their Hardness would be reduced to less than 0, they gain a weakness to acid and fire damage equal to 1 or increase these values by 1 if they already had a weakness. Flammable objects within 5 feet of the bomb’s target immediately catch on fire, taking 1d4 fire damage each round until extinguished, regardless of the outcome of the bomb’s attack roll. Many types grant an item bonus to attack rolls.

Kiln-Hardened.name: Kiln-Hardened
Kiln-Hardened.description:
Trigger You take fire damage.

Fire causes you to become harder and more durable, as the clay making up your body begins to bake. Until the end of your next turn, you gain a +1 status bonus to AC and to Fortitude saves, but suffer a –1 status penalty to Reflex and a –5-foot status penalty to your Speed. After this hardening, the magic animating you returns you to its more malleable form.

Enhancement When using this reaction, you gain resistance 5 to fire, piercing, and slashing damage until the end of your next turn.

Scorch Earth.name: Scorch Earth
Scorch Earth.description:
Requirements You’re channeling your dragon and are standing on earth or ground.

You can cause the very ground beneath you to scorch when you are connected to your dragon. You deal @Damage[20d6[fire]] fire damage with a @Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic] save in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30] and create hazardous terrain that deals @Damage[(floor(@actor.level/2))[fire]] equal to half your level each time a creature passes through a space occupied by the flame. This hazardous terrain lasts while you’re channeling your dragon and you ignore the damage from your own hazardous terrain. When you Sustain your channel imperial dragon, you can choose to suppress the hazardous terrain until the beginning of your next turn. You can Dismiss this effect.

Tool Reading.name: Tool Reading
Tool Reading.description:
You understand tools on a profoundly personal level, giving you insights that humanoids can never know. You become trained in Crafting. If you’re already trained in Crafting, you instead gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.QLeMH5mQgh28sa5o]{Specialty Crafting} skill feat for the specialty that best matches your composition. (e.g. Bookmaking for paper umbrellas and Blacksmithing for swords)

You also gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to notice unusual details in tools. This bonus applies to checks to discover mechanical traps on tools or connected to tools. It also applies to creatures disguising themselves as tools. If you aren’t using the Seek action or searching, the GM automatically rolls a secret check for you to notice unusual tools anyway. This check doesn’t gain your circumstance bonus.

External Alchemy.name: External Alchemy
External Alchemy.description: As within, so without. Cultivators liken the body to an alchemical cauldron, whether it refines food or qi. While most cultivators focus their efforts practicing internal alchemy, purifying and compressing their body, mind, and spirit into something greater, you would be remiss to ignore the external counterparts and its applications. You gain the advanced alchemy benefits. You can use advanced alchemy to create four alchemical elixir consumables each day.

Sky Dragon's Eyes (Lesser).name: Sky Dragon's Eyes (Lesser)
Sky Dragon's Eyes (Lesser).description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

These pale cheese curd balls resemble the eyes of sky dragons and taste light and airy. After you eat this cheese curd, you gain a sky dragon’s mist vision for the listed duration—fog and mist don’t impair your vision; ignore the concealed condition from fog and mist for 10 minutes.

Joseongyin Shrinekeeper Dedication.name: Joseongyin Shrinekeeper Dedication
Joseongyin Shrinekeeper Dedication.description:
Acess You are from Yaju.

You served as an attendant at the Joyaga, an ancient aviary for a flock of sparrows believed to be a physical manifestation of the Thousand-Souled Chorus. You become an expert in Religion and trained in Performance, or trained in another skill of your choice if you were already trained in Performance. You gain the Cast a Spell activity. You can prepare @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.tXa5vOu5giBNCjdR]{Know the Way} as a divine cantrip. You’re trained in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics. Your key spellcasting attribute for spells you gained from this archetype is Charisma, and they are divine spells. You become bound by Phi Deva’s edicts and anathema.

Special This feat counts as the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.smCDaPlpRDA47xjK]{Cleric Dedication} for the purposes of selecting @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.gc24C5CyWgqn1Lbl]{Basic Cleric Spellcasting}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.PLTOCEAvqBS05pZu]{Expert Cleric Spellcasting}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.bc6tcXSzakyCbQsS]{Master Cleric Spellcasting}.

Create Eddies.name: Create Eddies
Create Eddies.description:
Your kami forces air—or water if underwater—to swirl around you in eddies, with the disturbance growing stronger the longer you remain in one place. Your kami assists you, making all ranged attacks against you take a –1 circumstance penalty to the attack roll until the end of your next turn.

You can choose to Sustain this effect on subsequent turns, and if you do the penalty increases by 1, up to a maximum of –4. If you move on a turn where you Sustain the effect, the penalty returns to –1.

Lingering Anamnesis.name: Lingering Anamnesis
Lingering Anamnesis.description:
You remember some of the abilities and skills you had from before you became an automaton. Choose an ancestry that doesn’t have the construct trait that you belonged to in life. The chosen ancestry is your ancestry from your previous life. You gain a 1st-level weapon familiarity ancestry feat or a 1st-level ancestry feat that grants the Additional Lore skill feat. The ancestry feat you select must be from your chosen ancestry.

Enhancement Gain an additional 1st-level ancestry feat from the chosen ancestry, as long as the ancestry feat doesn't require any physiological feature that you lack.

Geojibom's Greatpick.name: Geojibom's Greatpick
Geojibom's Greatpick.description:
This pitch black +1 striking greatpick is made from alloys of reinforced metals forged by Geojibom’s breath. Strikes with this greatpick deal 1 extra fire damage. On a critical hit, the force of the greatpick’s impact unleashes a fiery explosion that deals @Damage[2d6[fire]] damage to all creatures within 10 feet of your target except for yourself with a @Check[reflex|dc:20|basic] save. Creatures who critically fail their save are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled}for 1 round.

Activate—Cast a Spell

Effect You cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.vJZ83ehQiM906lea]{Detect Metal} cantrip. In addition to metal, you are also aware of gemstones and other precious materials that are naturally occurring in earth and would be considered valuable treasure by an underworld dragon.

Mole Mine (Moderate).name: Mole Mine (Moderate)
Mole Mine (Moderate).description:
Activate 1 (Manipulate)

This device looks like a very large mole but is a magical wooden construct. It must be placed on soil or ground when Activated, whereupon it burrows just under the surface of the ground 30 feet in a direction of your choice and ends its movement in a single 5-foot square, leaving no tunnels or signs of its passing. For up to 1 minute, if a creature moves on the ground within 5- foot emanation of the mole mine, it immediately resurfaces near the creature and explodes, dealing @Damage[2d6[fire],2[persistent,fire]]damage (@Check[reflex|dc:17|basic]) to all creatures in a 5-foot burst centered on the corner of the creature closest to the bomb that moved through the area.

Biaoshi Training.name: Biaoshi Training
Biaoshi Training.description:
Access access to training from a biaoshi ranger

You favor rugged weapons that can be easily maintained on the march and used as tools in harsh terrain, and which can be used to great effect when fighting large numbers of opponents. When you are wielding simple axes, spears, and swords, you increase the damage die size by one step. In addition, your melee attacks with simple and martial axes, spears, and swords with the forceful or sweep traits gain the deadly d6 trait, or increase the die size from deadly by one step if it already had the deadly trait.

Fan Strikes.name: Fan Strikes
Fan Strikes.description:
Requirements You are wielding a Minatan weapon with the twin trait.

You deliver a punishing blow from the right side and snap your wrist in a fan-shaped motion, instantly delivering a second blow from the opposite direction. Make two melee Strikes against the same target, each using your current multiple attack penalty. The target is automatically @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against the second Strike. If both Strikes hit, combine their damage, apply the twin weapon damage bonus twice instead of once, and then add any other applicable effects from both weapons.

Tools of Necessity.name: Tools of Necessity
Tools of Necessity.description: You’ve become more efficient with your tools, being able to craft objects and attempt to help others. You can use the weapons from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.player-options.cm0dPrNNQDP3W15Y]{Tools of the Monsoon} as if they were artisan’s tools for Crafting checks to woodworking. You gain the potency value of these weapons to these checks if you are wielding it.

Lesson of Patience.name: Lesson of Patience
Lesson of Patience.description:
Your kami has taught you that with time, any material may be humbled by nature. Touch a creature in melee range, your kami assisting you by empowering your touch binding each of you to the earth for up to 1 minute. You and the target are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} for as long as the effect is active and the target must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. It must attempt a new save against the effect at the beginning of each of its turns. The target can attempt to Escape the immobilized condition, ending the effect entirely.

Critical Success The target is unaffected or reduces its slowed condition by 2 if it was already slowed by this effect. If the slowed condition is reduced to 0, the effect immediately ends.

Success As critical success, except the slowed condition is reduced by 1.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} or increases its slowed value by 1 if it was already slowed from this effect. If the value of the creature’s slowed condition ever exceeds 3, the target must attempt an additional Fortitude save, and on a failure it becomes petrified permanently as it solidifies into wood. This additional save has the incapacitation trait.

Critical Failure As failure, but the initial slowed value is 2 and the slowed value increases by 2 instead of 1.

Minatan Warrior Dedication.name: Minatan Warrior Dedication
Minatan Warrior Dedication.description:
Access Tian Xia Origin

Your Minatan warrior training imparts a foundation of fighting techniques and turns kalis into natural extensions of your body. You become trained in your choice of Acrobatics or Athletics and in Tian Xia Lore; if you were already trained, you become an expert instead. For the purposes of proficiency, you treat martial minatan weapons as simple weapons and advanced minatan weapons as martial weapons.

Special You can’t select another dedication feat until you’ve gained two other feats from the Minatan Warrior archetype.

Call Tribulation Lightning.name: Call Tribulation Lightning
Call Tribulation Lightning.description: While most cultivators prepare as they might to avoid Heaven’s wrath, you deliberately court death by calling down heavenly tribulation in its most common form. You and each enemy in a 20-foot radius and a 500-foot tall cylinder centered on your space takes @Damage[(9+max(0,(ceil((@actor.level -9)/2)*2)))d6[electricity]] damage with a @Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. The divine power within the electricity punishes the spirit as well; a creature takes @Damage[(9+max(0,(ceil((@actor.level -9)/2)*2)))d6[spirit]] damage instead of electricity damage from Call Tribulation Lightning if that would be more detrimental to the creature (as determined by the GM). At 10th level, and every 2 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 2d6.

Defend the Convoy.name: Defend the Convoy
Defend the Convoy.description:
Trigger Your prey is within your reach and successfully Strikes your convoy.

You defend your cargo with a decisive show of force, dissuading brigandry and predation with frightful violence. Make a melee strike against your prey. If you hit, your prey becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical hit.

Chorus Made Manifest.name: Chorus Made Manifest
Chorus Made Manifest.description:
You channel Phi Deva into your physical form. For 1 minute, you gain the ability to shift form from your current form to a battle form that resembles a chiliad flock of birds, sparrow-shaped flickers of shadow and feather that are Tiny creatures. You can assume this form as part of casting this spell and you can alternate between your normal form and your battle form as a single action with the concentrate trait for the duration. While in this form, you gain the animal and swarm traits. You don’t gain the swarm mind ability, so you are still affected normally by mental effects. You can Dismiss the spell.

You gain the following statistics and abilities:

  • You gain resistance 8 to physical damage and a weakness 8 to area and splash damage.

  • You can fit into spaces only a few inches wide, moving your birds through the gap.

  • Low-light vision and a fly Speed of 60 feet.

  • You gain a Choral Swarm Attack which deals 4d6 sonic damage with a basic Fortitude save to all creatures in a 15- foot cone which you can use a single action. Creatures that critically fail their Fortitude save are also deafened for 1 round. You cannot make Strikes while in this form.

Zodiac Spirit.name: Zodiac Spirit
Zodiac Spirit.description: Your zodiac’s powers have affected your form, giving you new abilities. While in sentinel form, you gain a trait appropriate for the creature of your zodiac, such as the animal or dragon trait (subject to GM discretion). You gain physical features according to your constellation, such as cat ears, dragon horns, or a puppy’s tail and your choice of low-light vision or scent as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet. If you already have low- light vision, you gain darkvision instead. You gain an unarmed attack in the brawling group that does 1d6 bludgeoning, slashing, or piercing damage that has the agile and finesse trait. Once made, these choices cannot be changed.

Energy Attunement.name: Energy Attunement
Energy Attunement.description: You align your qi with a specific destructive energy or element, warding your body and soul against it. During your daily preparations, choose one of the following traits: air (slashing), cold, earth (bludgeoning), electricity, fire, metal (slashing), poison, sonic, vitality, void, water (bludgeoning), or wood (piercing). You become attuned to this trait and can choose for any force or spirit damage dealt by your cultivator feats or spells to instead gain the trait and deal the corresponding damage type. If you choose void or vitality, you can use Cycle Energy with both void and vitality damage. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.misc.RAp8SWvF6AZqR2zr]{Cycle Energy} reaction.

Monstrous Turn.name: Monstrous Turn
Monstrous Turn.description:
Trigger A creature makes a melee Strike against you while you’re @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to it.

As a foe tries to catch you unaware, you suddenly shapeshift your face through your back and confront them head-on. Before the triggering attack happens, roll an Intimidation check to Demoralize the attacker.

Geojibom's Guidance.name: Geojibom's Guidance
Geojibom's Guidance.description:
This knotted maedeup charm is made of silky whiskers with an oily sheen and two white jade beads carved to look like bonsai leaves. Whatever it touches smells heavily of sap and dust. Each bead functions as a separate wand that you can Activate, but both lose their magical properties if one breaks.

Activate Cast a Spell; Frequency once per day, plus overcharge; Effect You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.0qaqksrGGDj74HXE]{Revealing Light}. After you cast the spell, you emanate bright light out to 10 feet and dim light 10 feet from your bright light for 1 minute. You automatically gain the effects of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.gpzpAAAJ1Lza2JVl]{Detect Magic} spell within the bright light. This effect has the detection and light traits.

Disembody.name: Disembody
Disembody.description:
Your attack was so forceful that you rattled your target’s soul. When you critically succeed at a Strike that dealt spirit damage from Qi-Empowered Blows, the creature must also attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and becomes temporarily immune to Disembody for 1 day.

Success The target gains a weakness to spirit damage equal to half your level for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.misc.QHVWgtxWBTsqiDRx]{Effect: Disembody (Spirit Weakness)}

Failure As success, except the target’s mind and soul is knocked out of their body in addition to the normal effects, causing the target to be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for 1 round.

Critical Failure As failure, except the target’s soul is pushed 20 feet away from their body in a direction of your choice and the body falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}. The body remains unconscious and takes no actions until the soul returns to the body. When the creature would normally take its turn, the soul gains 3 actions. The soul has the same stats as the creature except the soul can’t act other than to take actions that help it return to its body, it has the incorporeal trait, a fly Speed of 5 feet with no other types of movement, and is immune to all damage except force, ghost touch, and spirit. If the soul does not return to its body within 1 minute of being separated, the soul permanently manifests as a ghost and the creature dies. When you use the Energize effect for your Qi-Empowered Blows, you can continue to make Strikes against the target’s soul as if your Strikes had the ghost touch property rune for as long as it is imprinted.

Pham Lê Ngọc's Sightglasses.name: Pham Lê Ngọc's Sightglasses
Pham Lê Ngọc's Sightglasses.description:
The sightglass is a circle of glass with a slight iridescent sheen set in a loop of brass with a cover. When the device is closed, it resembles a savonette pocket watch, and the cover is embossed with Pham Lê Ngọc’s personal seal.

Activate 1 (manipulate) You either open the device and hold it up to your eye or you close the device and wear it. The effect of the item changes depending on your usage.

Held You can understand the meaning of Draconic as a written language when you read it through the sightglass. This effect doesn’t let you understand codes, language couched in metaphor, and the like (subject to GM discretion). You don’t need investiture to use this effect.

Worn You gain a +2 item bonus to Society checks while within Xa Hoi as well as all Xa Hoi Lore checks.

Lesson of Impermanence.name: Lesson of Impermanence
Lesson of Impermanence.description: Your soul is bound to destiny, entangled fully to the kami and their spiritual realm. If you die while an emanation of your soul is present in the world, your kami will spirit itself away to this location. Your kami then regrows your body in a spiritual process that takes 1 day with full Hit Points and the same spells prepared and Focus Points you had in your Focus Pool when you died, and with the same long-term conditions of the old body. This new body is identical to your original body but does not have any of your equipment. You are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 1 day after you are revived.

Feed on Wood.name: Feed on Wood
Feed on Wood.description:
Trigger You take damage from a weapon made primarily of wood or affected by a spell with the wood trait.

Requirements You’re channeling your dragon.

The wood feeds your appetite for destruction. You gain a +4 status bonus to damage to your Strikes and to your spells or effects with the fire trait until the end of your next turn.

Tiger's Judgment.name: Tiger's Judgment
Tiger's Judgment.description:
Requirements You are wielding two hook swords.

You choose a single enemy and exact judgment with all the ferocity of a cornered tiger. Make up to four melee Strikes with your hook swords against the enemy, but you only increase your multiple attack penalty if you miss your Strike. You double your circumstance bonus from the twin trait with these Strikes. Regardless of the result, the enemy is temporarily immune to Tiger’s Judgment for 1 day.

Shei Long's Blade (True).name: Shei Long's Blade (True)
Shei Long's Blade (True).description:
This +3 major striking ghost touch katana is crafted from the bright jade ore that is the foundation of Zi Ha’s mountains. The blade is blessed by Tsukiyo’s moonlight, and its edge is infused with Shei Long’s tooth.

Activate—Judgement of the Sky r (manipulate, electricity) Trigger Your attack roll with Shei Long's blade is a critical sucess

Effect The judgment of the heavens flows from the blade. Your target takes @Damage[8d8[electricity]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}. All the target’s allies within 20 feet take @Damage[4d8[electricity]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:43|basic] Reflex save. Creatures who critically fail their save are slowed 1.

Spirit Orchestra.name: Spirit Orchestra
Spirit Orchestra.description: Your connection to the spirits grows to create a full band. You can create up to four @Template[type:burst|distance:20]{20-foot bursts} of spirit performers when you summon spirit performers and they can be within 60 feet instead of 30 feet.

Lesson of Pain.name: Lesson of Pain
Lesson of Pain.description: Your kami has taught you that pain begets pain in vicious cycles. This lesson offers no comfort, only insight while you fight. Make a Strike. If your Strike is successful, you can choose to invoke this lesson by calling on your kami for assistance, causing an object or weapon the creature is holding to become overwhelmed with spiritual barbs. The creature can choose to Release the held item immediately or it takes @Damage[4d6[spirit]] damage with a basic @Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. The target additionally takes 4d6 spirit damage at the end of each turn that they are holding an item under this effect. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn, but you can Sustain the effect on subsequent turns to extend the duration to the end of your next turn.

My Knowledge To Yours.name: My Knowledge To Yours
My Knowledge To Yours.description: With experience as a conductor and a teacher, you pass your knowledge to those who need it. During your daily preparations, you can teach an ally how to participate in a tang mai orchestration you know. When you summon your spirit performers, they also appear around your ally in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:20] as an aura and it grant the effects of your orchestration to allies in the area for the duration.

Lady Nanbyo (The Relict of Rebirth).name: Lady Nanbyo (The Relict of Rebirth)
Lady Nanbyo (The Relict of Rebirth).description:
Many in Tian Xia focus on only the destruction Lady Nanbyo brings and not what happens afterwards. Many more continue to ignore who she was before the injustices she faced. Her presence alone foreshadows impending doom, but not the perseverance to survive. Lady Nanbyo is more than a cautionary tale, she is the harbinger of a new world. She is the hand that guides you out of self destruction and onto the path of redemption. Followers of Lady Nanbyo understand that the natural disasters pave the path for new life and that for one to be reborn, they must first die. More devout followers revel in righteous fury and will encourage the healthy release of anger, sorrow, and frustration. To be reborn is to be free and sometimes, freedom requires starting from scratch.

Title The Relict of Rebirth

Areas of Concern growth, healing, moving forward, rebirth

Edicts aid in the healing process, seek out comfort in nature, allow yourself to achieve catharsis

Anathema intervene in the natural cycle of life, allow yourself to be held back by the past, allow others to slight you

Mountain Mech Mahjong Tile.name: Mountain Mech Mahjong Tile
Mountain Mech Mahjong Tile.description:
A mountain mech is a machine forged from thick stainless Honggal steel and designed with Samsaran ingenuity and innovation. Most Samsaran guilds possess them and grant members an item which resembles a mahjong tile to summon them.

Resembling a crab with long, spindly legs, the mountain mech has a thorax that houses its power core. Fully powered mountain mechs last for approximately 4 hours, depending on activity. To allow for moonlight to properly strike and recharge the core, the solid Tsukiyo jade core is barely covered by the mountain mech’s frame and is nestled within the structure. A depleted core requires 4 hours to recharge, but the mech can charge while active if operating under moonlight. The mountain mech has six sturdy legs to help with nimble and flexible movement over various terrain. Mountain mechs are usually programmed for tasks based on their guild's needs. While they are able to engage in combat, they are actively programmed to protect their allies from dangers.

Activate—Summon Mech 2 (manipulate) Frequency once per day

Effect When you draw a special symbol onto the mahjong summoning tile, you summon a mountain mech into an adjacent free space. The mountain mech can perform all the usual duties of regular mountain mechs and has similar charging requirements. The mountain mech teleports back to its guild if you summon another mech or if it’s destroyed or runs out of power.

Communicative Dance.name: Communicative Dance
Communicative Dance.description: Dance, regardless of its origins, communicates ideas, stories, and concepts without needing to speak a single word. Minatan bladedancers are particularly artful in communicating through rhythm and flow alone. While communicating with a creature who does not speak any languages you speak but is capable of complex thought, you can attempt to speak to the creature through dance, but you can usually only convey simple concepts. You can use Performance to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.DCb62iCBrJXy0Ik6]{Request} from creatures in this way, but you increase the time it takes to complete the action or activity by 10 times the normal amount.

prerequisites.value: Karenza Bladedancer Dedication or Maglalatik Dancer Dedication

Kaiju Harvester.name: Kaiju Harvester
Kaiju Harvester.description:
When a kaiju falls, the scavengers like you come to collect. You are a harvester, a butcher specialized in carving up the corpses of kaiju. You know where to cut, what to sell, what is and isn’t edible, and most importantly, how to make it last. It takes great skill and experience to clean up after a kaiju, making you the perfect recruit for adventuring.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Kaiju Lore skill. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.8qebBeOJsyRIchcu]{Forager} skill feat. You can spend 1 hour carving the remains of a recently slain Large creature, usually an animal or beast, to gain the effects of a successful Subsist.

Spawn of Kawuk.name: Spawn of Kawuk
Spawn of Kawuk.description:
Your companion is a Spinosaurus, Baryonyx, or another semi- aquatic carnivorous dinosaur. It may be one of Kawuk’s many spawn, who’s precise appearance shifts every year.

Size large

Melee 1 jaws, Damage 1d8 piercing

Melee 1 claws (agile), Damage 1d6 slashing

Str +3, Dex +1, Con +3, Int -4, Wis +1, Cha +0

Hit Points 8

Skill Survival

Senses low-light vision, scent (imprecise, 30 feet)

Speed 30 feet, swim 30 feet

Special The spawn has the amphibious trait.

Support Benefit Your spawn menaces your foes, rendering them vulnerable to your attacks. Until the end of your next turn, foes adjacent to the Spawn are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against your melee attacks.

Advanced Maneuver @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.misc.yCJ3GQgirMZHlulw]{Eviscerate}

Fluttering Movement.name: Fluttering Movement
Fluttering Movement.description:
Trigger Your turn begins.

Requirements You are channeling your dragon.

You can move more quickly. Make an @Check[acrobatics|dc:@self.level] check against a standard DC of your level. If you succeed, your feet float with your movements allowing you to ignore the first 5-foot square of difficult terrain you encounter during your next move action.

Black Pearl of Mewru.name: Black Pearl of Mewru
Black Pearl of Mewru.description:
Activate f (concentrate)

Trigger You attempt a save against a curse effect but haven't rolled yet.

These pearls are a shiny obsidian and the most prized exports of Mewru. They are highly sought after as jewelry and are believed to be dew from the heavens, able to ward off evil. When you Activate it, you gain a +2 status bonus to the triggering save and other saves against curses for 1 minute. On the triggering save, if the outcome of your roll is a failure, you get a success instead. If the outcome is a critical failure, you get a failure instead.

Draw, Breath, Shoot.name: Draw, Breath, Shoot
Draw, Breath, Shoot.description:
Requirements You are wielding a weapon in the bow weapon group and you are mounted.

Paradoxically, you feel most at peace when your horse runs freely and your bow is strung, seeing nothing but your target, your arrow an extension of your mind. Make a ranged Strike with the required weapon. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the attack roll and ignore the target's concealed condition. If the target is hidden, reduce the flat check from being hidden from 11 to 5.

Sayaw Ba Sangko Steps.name: Sayaw Ba Sangko Steps
Sayaw Ba Sangko Steps.description:
Your movements are finite but profound, keeping balance upon a razor's edge. You lean upon friend or foe, complementing their footwork or sending them falling. You can roll Performance instead of Acrobatics to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance}. When you successfully Balance with Performance, adjacent creatures gain your choice of a +1 circumstance bonus or a –1 circumstance penalty to their checks to Balance until the beginning of your next turn.

Special If you have Banga Balance, you can use Performance instead of Acrobatics to determine its effects and in place of the Acrobatics check for Banga Swap.

prerequisites.value: Karenza Bladedancer Dedication or Maglalatik Dancer Dedication

Inntake Strike.name: Inntake Strike
Inntake Strike.description: Using your own body as a weapon, you dive at a foe’s legs, impairing their mobility. Make an unarmed melee Strike. On a hit, the target takes a –10-foot status penalty to its Speed (or a –15- foot status penalty on a critical hit) until the end of your next turn. If the target has more than one Speed, you must pick one to reduce. This can’t reduce the Speed below 5 feet.

Sparkling Glory.name: Sparkling Glory
Sparkling Glory.description:
Trigger You critically succeeded at a skill check while adjacent to an enemy.

Requirements You’re in your sentinel form.

When you triumph, you send surges of sparkles through the air. Choose an enemy adjacent to you to make a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spellcasting DC (whichever is higher) or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round. On a critical failure, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round and dazzled for 1 minute instead. Regardless of the result, the enemy is temporarily immune to Sparkling Glory for 10 minutes.

Arindham's Whip.name: Arindham's Whip
Arindham's Whip.description:
This leathery, moss-covered +1 striking rooting whip is made from a petrified lizardfolk’s tongue, gnarled peachwood and Arindham’s whiskers. Foes who are bioengineered, artificial, or corrupted in some way, including but not limited to creatures with the aberration, construct, and undead traits, are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to you while they are immobilized by the whip’s rooting rune. You can use the following action when holding the whip.

Activate—Crack of the Vine 1 (manipulate) Frequency once per hour

Effect For 1 round, razor-sharp thorns cover Arindham’s whip—it loses the nonlethal trait and attacks also deal @Damage[1d4[bleed]] damage.

Denounce the Apostate.name: Denounce the Apostate
Denounce the Apostate.description: You expound upon the failings of an unworthy individual to bring them to justice before Heaven. When you select this feat, choose holy or unholy, depending on your allegiances. When you make a Strike that would deal Strategic Strike damage to a creature with an opposing trait, you can convert the precision damage from your Strategic Strike to spirit damage and your Strike gains the corresponding trait and the spirit trait.

Pragmatic Resources.name: Pragmatic Resources
Pragmatic Resources.description: While professional armies have support crews to maintain their gear, you instead travel light and do everything by yourself to ensure you keep to your clients’ tight schedules. This has honed your resourcefulness in maintaining weapons and armor that you haven’t had the time or money to replace. You become an expert in Crafting and gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.ASy9AKEIRxPYUi5o]{Quick Repair} skill feat or another 1st level skill feat for Crafting if you already had Quick Repair. You can wield shields and weapons with the broken trait as if they were not broken.

Prong Typhoon Stance.name: Prong Typhoon Stance
Prong Typhoon Stance.description:
Requirements You are wielding at least one sai.

You enter an impenetrable stance, intercepting incoming blows, then battering them aside. While you are in this stance, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to Disarm, and successful Disarm actions grant a +3 circumstance bonus to further Disarm actions instead of +2. In addition, you can attempt to Disarm creatures up to two sizes larger than you.

Shepherd From Harm.name: Shepherd From Harm
Shepherd From Harm.description:
Trigger An ally within reach of your hook swords is the target of a ranged Strike or an area effect that requires a save.

Quickly using the hooks to drag an ally, you save them from harm. You move a willing ally up to 5 feet in any direction, as long as they end within reach of a hook sword you are wielding. Your ally uses its new location for determining any bonuses to its AC or saves against the effect. If the ally would be moved out of the area of effect or otherwise impossible to target with the Strike, it treats its degree of success on its save as one step better or the degree of success on the Strike as one step worse and this action gains the fortune or misfortune trait respectively.

Spoken Like the Sages of Old.name: Spoken Like the Sages of Old
Spoken Like the Sages of Old.description:
Prerequisites Tien, Hwan, or Minkaian language

The virtues of the ancient sage-kings are best understood and expressed in the idioms and allusions of the Celestial Court. You learn the draconic and empyrean languages. In addition, when you attempt a linguistics action or activity that uses the draconic, empyrean, hwan, tien, or minkaian languages, you can use Society instead of Diplomacy to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} and instead of Performance to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.EEDElIyin4z60PXx]{Perform}.

Channel Imperial Dragon.name: Channel Imperial Dragon
Channel Imperial Dragon.description:
You channel the power of your imperial dragon ally. You begin channeling your dragon, gaining the traits for your dragon type. You gain resistance equal to half your level to the damage type of your dragon and a +1 status bonus to saves against effects with this trait.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.misc.Item.T1anyR2H0dGPnaYa]{Effect: Channel Imperial Dragon}

You can Sustain the spell to gain a +1 status bonus to checks to Diplomacy and Intimidation until the end of your next turn. This spell gains the tradition associated with your dragon.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.misc.Item.iGhsifgRECSITO8i]{Effect: Channel Imperial Dragon (Sustain)}

Heightened (+3) The status bonus to Diplomacy and Intimidation increases by 1.

Nascent Soul.name: Nascent Soul
Nascent Soul.description:
Attaining the vaunted peak of mortal cultivation, you refine your qi to such an uttermost degree that the golden core of your cultivation binds inimitably to your immortal soul, perhaps melding with it, to ever grow in refinement with further cultivation. Your qi retains your will even without a body, or collapses inward like a dying star to reveal a nascent godling. No matter the method, you now number among the true immortals, free to pursue divinity or rival and eclipse it in time.

Whenever you die, your soul stays behind, ready to return to the world of mortals. As long as there are no claims on your soul (such as a contract with a devil) and nothing is trapping your soul (such as being slain by a critical hit from a vilderavn), you may return to life whenever you desire at any location you’ve been in before that your soul can feasibly reach. The nature of this resurrection varies between cultivators, as some reconstitute their bodies in secluded locations and some steal the bodies of hapless commoners whose will they can overpower, their soul reshaping the bodies to meet their original appearance and ejecting the victim’s soul to meet its final judgement (which can only generally happen to creatures of level 0 or lower).

Regardless of the exact nature of your resurrection, you are fully resurrected one week after the start of your rebirth.

Alternatively, you may return to your body immediately after death, your qi animating your limbs and soul blazing like a bonfire; you do not die and heal yourself for half your total Hit Points, and Stand if you were prone. This act strains your nascent soul greatly, rendering your soul unable to stay behind for a week afterwards; should you die again before the week is over, your soul would pass to whatever afterlife you earned.

prerequisites.value: a cultivator feat that halts your aging such as The Bitter Scholar’s Promotion, The Immortal Attains the Summit, or Grasp the Truth

Shepherd's Pounce.name: Shepherd's Pounce
Shepherd's Pounce.description:
Requirements You are wielding two hook swords.

You launch yourself through the air, pouncing like a tiger. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}. If you end your movement within melee reach of at least one enemy, you can make a melee Strike with the required weapon against that enemy. If this Strike hits, you add the weapon damage dice of your second hook sword as additional damage to the Strike. This counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty.

Talibong.name: Talibong
Talibong.description: This long delicate blade can interchange between tactical thrusts to sweeping slashes with ease.

Climbing Claws.name: Climbing Claws
Climbing Claws.description: The hooks of the sword are useful to bite into walls, giving you an easier time climbing. You can use hook swords as if they were a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.9UJbMaglf35GVzaZ]{Climbing Kit} and you can add their potency value as an item bonus to your checks to Climb. When wielding a hook sword, it counts as a free hand for the purposes of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{Grab an Edge} reaction and you can use your attack modifier with hook swords instead of your Acrobatics or Reflex save to Grab an Edge if you are wielding a hook sword.

Terra-Cotta Weaponry.name: Terra-Cotta Weaponry
Terra-Cotta Weaponry.description:
Requirements You have access to soil or earth you could mold into a weapon.

Each Terra-cotta soldier is outfitted with weapons that, too, are made of clay. You have learned how to manipulate the clay into these forms. You use nearby soil to create a single weapon, or two weapons of the same type that have the agile or twin traits. You must be at least trained in the weapons you create. If you have invested handwraps of mighty blows, weapons created in this way gain its fundamental runes and its applicable property runes (any property runes that can't apply to the weapon you created are suppressed for the weapon). If you make a weapon that requires ammunition, you also make 20 pieces of ammunition for the weapon. These weapons last for 10 minutes before crumbling back into soil.

Enhancement Though made of simple clay, your weapons contain trace amounts of other materials. Your Terra-Cotta Weapons are considered silver and cold iron.

Ballad of Focus.name: Ballad of Focus
Ballad of Focus.description:
Your orchestra plays a song that inspires focus and determination.

Expert Allies who heard the song gain a +1 status bonus to their ranged attack rolls and to Will saves against emotion effects.

Master As expert, except the status bonus is +2.

Legendary As expert, except the status bonus is +3.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.misc.51p9GYeRsdQT7Mfp]{Effect: Ballad of Focus}

Natural Remedy.name: Natural Remedy
Natural Remedy.description:
Trigger You restore Hit Points to a creature

Your kami adds their primal powers to your attempts to heal. Your kami assists you by lending its spirit, and you restore an additional amount of Hit Points to the triggering creature equal to half your level.

Cat's Eye.name: Cat's Eye
Cat's Eye.description:
This mummified eye of a noble amurrun possesses enhanced magical properties from its original owner’s spellcasting abilities. When you wear the eye on your forehead, you gain a +2 item bonus to Perception checks in dim light and darkness.

Activate—See Mysteries 1 (manipulate, revelation) Frequency once per day;

You move the cat’s eye to temporarily mold into place over your eye. You gain the effects of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.jwK43yKsHTkJQvQ9]{See the Unseen} spell but become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}.

Karenza Bladedancer Dedication.name: Karenza Bladedancer Dedication
Karenza Bladedancer Dedication.description:
Access Minatan origin or familiar with minatan culture

Since the time when Hei Feng sundered the Taumatan Empire into a thousand islands with a singular slice of his mighty blade, the people of Minata have held sword culture in awe. What began as attempts to describe this mighty deed bled into dance, and the continuance of the legendary deed. Your practiced swordplay is a dance of flowing motions, subtle as the breeze, until it cleaves like the thunder of Hei Fang himself. You gain access to minatan knives and swords. For the purposes of proficiency, you treat martial knives and swords as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons. You gain the Karenza Stance action.

Habu Bites Itself.name: Habu Bites Itself
Habu Bites Itself.description:
Requirements You are wielding at least one sai.

You catch your opponent’s attack and redirect it into them. Make two Strikes against the same target with your sai, each using your current multiple attack penalty. You add any precision damage only once, to the attack of your choice. If both attacks hit, combine their damage, and then add any other applicable effects from either of your weapons. You deal 2 additional damage per weapon damage die of your sai if both your Strikes are successful. This additional damage is slashing damage or a damage type that the target creature could deal with one of its attacks. For instance, if both your Strikes were successful against a young omen dragon, you could choose to have the additional damage be bludgeoning, mental, or piercing instead of slashing.

Spirit Words.name: Spirit Words
Spirit Words.description:
Requirements You are not in an encounter

Being in touch with the primal life force that flows through all things allows you to communicate on a spiritual level. You attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.DCb62iCBrJXy0Ik6]{Request}, or a similar single action that requires that you communicate to a creature. The action doesn’t require that the target understand your language, so long as what you are communicating is simple and could be communicated in only a few words (subject to GM discretion). You can use this ability only to communicate with creatures that would have a spirit (normally this is only creatures that would be affected by spirit damage).

Energize You can ignore the normal requirements for Spirit Words.

Phi Deva's Sparrow Familiar.name: Phi Deva's Sparrow Familiar
Phi Deva's Sparrow Familiar.description: You have a sparrow at your side at all times. You gain a Sparrow of Phi Deva specific familiar.

Incredible Eagle.name: Incredible Eagle
Incredible Eagle.description: Your eagle is utterly majestic, dwarfing any other bird of prey in power and brilliance. Choose two of the following familiar abilities for your Pet eagle to gain as abilities: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.92lgSEPFIDLvKOCF]{Accompanist}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.7ZxPS0UU7pf7wjp0]{Ambassador}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.mK3mAUWiRLZZYNdz]{Damage Avoidance (Reflex)}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.BXssJhTJjKrfojwG]{Fast Movement (fly Speed)}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.2fiQzoEKu6YUnrU9]{Independent}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Ms8EVO2mNbr4Zp1i]{Item Delivery}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.qTxH8mSOvc4PMzrP]{Kinspeech}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Construct-Breakthroughs.A3UROfr7qu1iWNKy]{Manual Dexterity}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.v7zE3tKQb9G6PaYU]{Partner in Crime}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.jevzf9JbJJibpqaI]{Skilled}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.fmsVItn94FeY5Q3X]{Snoop}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.zyMRLQnFCQVpltiR]{Speech}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.aEKA3YWekLhEhuV8]{Threat Display}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Le8UWr5BU8rV3iBf]{Tough}. If you gain a new Pet eagle, you can choose 2 abilities for your new eagle to gain when you first gain it. If you select speech, you and the eagle can instead communicate in a way that only the two of you understand.

High Honors.name: High Honors
High Honors.description:
You were a successful military general or brilliant tactician, and your skill has not been dulled by becoming an automaton. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} skill feat for Warfare Lore. You can choose to use Warfare Lore instead of Perception when you roll for initiative for an encounter if you have spent at least 1 minute preparing for an encounter against a creature you can see or are aware is nearby and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus when you do.

Enhancement When you roll Warfare Lore for initiative, the circumstance bonus increases to +2 and each ally that can see you within 20 feet may draw a weapon as a free action when they roll for initiative.

Blended Melodies.name: Blended Melodies
Blended Melodies.description: You have blended two of your orchestrations into a perfect harmony. Choose two orchestrations you know. You combine the songs into a new orchestration unlike any other, granting you the benefits of both orchestrations when you successfully conduct the orchestration.

Diffuse Affliction.name: Diffuse Affliction
Diffuse Affliction.description:
You learn how to diffuse poisons and diseases from a patient, helping them recover by spreading the burden. Choose one willing creature that is currently affected by a disease or poison and one enemy within 30 feet of you, your kami assists you by summoning magical roots that connect the creatures. The willing creature immediately makes a saving throw against the disease or poison it is affected by, reducing its stage accordingly if successful. If the willing creature was subject to more than one disease or poison, you must choose one. The enemy must attempt a Fortitude save against the DC of the disease or poison with the following effects.

Success The enemy wards off the bindings to your ally and is unaffected.

Failure The enemy is subject to the poison at stage 1 or becomes sickened 1 if the willing creature was diseased.

Critical Failure As failure, except the stage of the poison and the sickened value increase to 2.

Fierce Reputation.name: Fierce Reputation
Fierce Reputation.description: The Terra-cotta army of Lingshen is famous across Golarion for their martial excellence. When interacting with a creature that has reverence for your heritage, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.tHCqgwjtQtzNqVvd]{Coerce}. In addition, you gain a +1 status bonus to your Will DC against checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} you.

Counterwit.name: Counterwit
Counterwit.description:
Trigger You would be targeted by a mental effect.

Requirements You’re channeling your imperial dragon.

Your wit is quick to thwart tricks of the mind. You gain a +2 status bonus against mental effects until the beginning of your next turn.

Step on the Wind.name: Step on the Wind
Step on the Wind.description:
You use qi as a force to propel yourself through non-solid surfaces. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap} into the air or onto a horizontal surface that could not normally hold your weight (such as a cloud or the surface of a pond). You do not fall, but treat the air or surface as if it were solid ground for the purposes of movement until the end of your turn, but you can only move horizontally if you leapt into the air.

Energize You Fly instead of Leap and gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed that lasts for 1 minute.

Eyes Everywhere.name: Eyes Everywhere
Eyes Everywhere.description: You mentally connect with tools, weapons, and raw materials throughout the battlefield, seeing from their perspectives. Once per day, you can briefly awaken items around you to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.ykyKclKTCMp2SFXa]{Countless Eyes} as a 4th-rank innate spell of the same tradition as the one you selected for the read aura cantrip of Inquisitive Eye.

Percussive Rhythm.name: Percussive Rhythm
Percussive Rhythm.description:
Trigger You are targeted with a Strike or you hit with a coconut shell Strike.

Requirements You're in maglalatik stance.

You leverage the attacks of your enemies into a soothing musical transition, elevating your dance. You immediately @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.EEDElIyin4z60PXx]{Perform}.

Pham Lê Ngọc's Ceremonial Sword.name: Pham Lê Ngọc's Ceremonial Sword
Pham Lê Ngọc's Ceremonial Sword.description:
This +1 striking shifting low-grade cold iron liuyedao comes in an intricately ornamented scabbard covered with designs of imperial dragons. In addition to its ability to shift into different weapon types, the blade and scabbard can transform their appearance to pass as official ceremonial swords of any nation the wielder has seen, granting a +1 item bonus to Deception checks to pass as a diplomat of that nation. The blade may also be allowed in areas where weapons are otherwise banned, at the GM’s discretion, due to its function as a diplomatic status symbol.

Activate—Focused Attack 2 (concentrate, flourish, manipulate) Requirements You haven't attacked your target today

Effect You have one chance to take out a target. Make a Strike. Your outcome is one degree of success better than what you rolled. If the outcome was already a critical success, your target takes an additional @Damage[2d6[precision]]{2d6 precision} damage.

Imperious Calamity.name: Imperious Calamity
Imperious Calamity.description:
Requirements You’re channeling your imperial dragon.

You call upon your dragon’s power to visit disaster on your enemies.You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.kVNo3ga0lwLKPrem]{Summon Elemental Herald} as an innate spell of your dragon’s tradition. You must choose the element that matches the trait you gained from your imperial dragon. This activity gains the tradition associated with your dragon.

Imperishable.name: Imperishable
Imperishable.description: A bite of dry biscuits, a handful of grain, or a mouthful of water; these are enough to sustain you on the march.Though far from pleasant, it is a facet of bitter work and hard labor which will keep you alive regardless of harsh terrain, impossible deadlines, or the dishonesty of opportunists whose offers of hospitality could come at too high a price. When you haven't eaten or drank enough to survive comfortably, you ignore the fatigued condition that occurs due to starvation or thirst. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves against poisons and drugs; this increases to a +2 circumstance bonus against ingested poisons and drugs.

Manifest Imperial Element.name: Manifest Imperial Element
Manifest Imperial Element.description:
Requirements You’re channeling your dragon.

You focus all the power channeled from your imperial dragon to temporarily create an elemental creature who fights on your behalf. You end the effects of channel imperial dragon immediately and produce the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.kghwmH3tQjMIhdH1]{Summon Dragon} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.lpT6LotUaQPfinjj]{Summon Elemental} but you must select a creature that shares a type with your imperial dragon. The effects of the spell are heightened to a rank equal to half your level rounded up and the creature gains 2 actions for the turn when you use this activity and when you Sustain the effect.

Tambol Ritualist.name: Tambol Ritualist
Tambol Ritualist.description: You have mastered the ability to use dance to appease spirits and invoke guidance in the form of rituals. You can always use Performance to perform a ritual. You learn two uncommon 2nd- rank rituals now. At 10th level and every 4 levels thereafter, you learn two more uncommon rituals with a maximum rank of half that level.

prerequisites.value: Karenza Bladedancer Dedication or Maglalatik Dancer Dedication

Folklore Actor.name: Folklore Actor
Folklore Actor.description:
You are more than just a regular street performer during the holiday season. You serve a valuable role as an actor, taking on the roles of mythic heroes, gods and monsters. Be they cautionary tales, historic epics, or religious parables; your stories are lessons to be learned. You are accustomed to fanciful costumes, extravagant masks, and the clamor of parades. Now you seek the open road, new roles to embody, and fresh faces to inspire.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Charisma or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in your choice of the Performance skill, and gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.7LB00jkh6JaJr3vS]{Fascinating Performance} skill feat or the Intimidation skill, and gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.xQMz6eDgX75WX2ce]{Intimidating Glare} skill feat. You’re trained in the Folklore Lore skill.

Residual Empowered Strikes.name: Residual Empowered Strikes
Residual Empowered Strikes.description: Your focus on the flow of energy between you and your opponent enables you to execute a series of attacks with incredible accuracy. When you use Qi-Empowered Blows and make a successful Strike, you can carry the damage into further Strikes by reducing your Hit Points by the same amount. You can do this for as many Strikes as you make before the end of your turn, reducing your Hit Points each time you renew the effect.

Kami Symbiosis.name: Kami Symbiosis
Kami Symbiosis.description: You further entwine your soul with the kami, granting you more of its powers. You gain one of the free actions you did not select from the Body of the Kami Dedication.

Shei Long's Blade (Greater).name: Shei Long's Blade (Greater)
Shei Long's Blade (Greater).description:
This +2 striking ghost touch katana is crafted from the bright jade ore that is the foundation of Zi Ha’s mountains. The blade is blessed by Tsukiyo’s moonlight, and its edge is infused with Shei Long’s tooth.

Activate—Judgement of the Sky r (manipulate, electricity) Trigger Your attack roll with Shei Long's blade is a critical sucess

Effect The judgment of the heavens flows from the blade. Your target takes @Damage[4d8[electricity]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}. All the target’s allies within 20 feet take @Damage[2d8[electricity]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:28|basic] Reflex save. Creatures who critically fail their save are slowed 1.

Grasp the Truth.name: Grasp the Truth
Grasp the Truth.description:
You have glimpsed a sublime truth about your being, causing your body and spirit to meld with your convictions until you have transcended to become as much an idea as you are a person. While ordinary mortals must rely upon a hopeful core to their being that a better tomorrow is possible should they only try; you are now possessed of an indomitable core of self-knowledge. You shall not die, and shall not rest, such is the depths of your conviction. Until all that dares to impose its will upon mortal life is reduced to dust, you will draw strength from this truth.

You cease aging. If you ever cease to pursue the edict provided in the Breath of Righteousness feat for longer than a year and a day, you resume aging until you conduct an atone ritual.

In addition, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.zGrUu3dUtqHrqGuo]{Break Curse} skill feat despite not meeting the prerequisites and can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.y3jlOfgsQH1JjkJE]{Anointed Ground} once per hour as an occult innate spell and without spending its cost. Alternatively, you can spend 8 hours casting anointed ground as an exploration activity, heightening its rank to half your level rounded up, and extending its duration to 1 month.

Three-Finger Fist Dedication.name: Three-Finger Fist Dedication
Three-Finger Fist Dedication.description: You have trained to use sai as deadly instruments and weapons of peace. When you wield sai, their damage die changes to 1d6 instead of 1d4, and they gain the Parry trait. You don’t take the –2 circumstance penalty for making nonlethal attacks with sai.

Arc Between Metal.name: Arc Between Metal
Arc Between Metal.description:
Requirements You’re channeling your dragon.

Your familiarity with your sky dragon allows you to teleport yourself between metal objects as an arc of electricity. Choose a metal object within your reach and a second metal object within 100 feet of you that forms an unobstructed line with the first object. You transform into pure electricity, creating an arc of electricity between the two points and teleporting to a square adjacent to the second metal object. All creatures between the two points take @Damage[10d6[electricity]] damage with a @Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

Insult To Injury.name: Insult To Injury
Insult To Injury.description:
Requirements You are wielding at least one sai.

Your sai become brutal instruments that exploit your foes’ every mistake. When you successfully Disarm a creature, you can deal bludgeoning damage to that creature equal to your Strength modifier. You can make this attack nonlethal with no penalty.

Recollection of Self.name: Recollection of Self
Recollection of Self.description: Once per day, you can spend 1 Mythic Point to manifest your soulforged armament’s essence form, even if you have already done so previously today.

Imperial Kyoryū.name: Imperial Kyoryū
Imperial Kyoryū.description:
When nature is pushed to the brink, it defends itself by manifesting kyoryū. When you cast channel imperial dragon to enter a dragon form, it has the following heightened effect.

Heightened (10th) Your battle form is Gargantuan, and your attacks have 15-foot reach (or 20-foot reach if they previously had 10-foot reach). You instead gain AC = 25 + your level, 30 temporary HP, an attack modifier of +33, a damage bonus of +24, and Athletics +35. Your Dragon Breath deals an additional 8d6 damage. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.misc.jAfqq7Tcffg7M592]{Kyoryū’s Wrath} action.

Primordial Heart (CC).name: Primordial Heart (CC)
Primordial Heart (CC).description: Your eidolon’s heart is a swirling wellspring of ancient sorceries and primordial energies allowing it to rejuvenate its vigor in the heat of combat. Choose two energy damage types other than force. Whenever your eidolon deals one of those damage types with the damage from its unarmed attacks, or a damage type available to it through Energy Heart or Dual Energy Heart, it may instead deal one of the others. Your eidolon gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.misc.v4PgPuSIDHHqHtc9]{Primordial Regeneration} free action.

Glazed and Fired.name: Glazed and Fired
Glazed and Fired.description:
You have been coated in glazes and tempered in fire. When you use Kiln-Hardened, your outer layer gains a striking color as it hardens. If the triggering creature is within 30 feet of you, it must make a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save against your class or spellcasting DC, whichever is higher. Creatures that fail this Will save are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by you until the end of your next turn, as they are mesmerized by your new colors.

Enhancement All creatures within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:15] must make a Will save instead of only the triggering creature.

Amorphous Assist.name: Amorphous Assist
Amorphous Assist.description: You rapidly change your shape and pull an ally away from a hostile effect. You can use the Aid reaction to grant a bonus to an ally’s Reflex save. As usual, you must spend an action on your turn to prepare to Aid.

Sword Qi Wave.name: Sword Qi Wave
Sword Qi Wave.description:
You gather your qi and unleash it in a cone of destructive energy. Each creature in the area takes 3d10 force damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d10.

Emissary to the Sea.name: Emissary to the Sea
Emissary to the Sea.description: Channeling a sea dragon helps you feel at home underwater. While under the effects of channel imperial dragon, you can breathe underwater and gain a swim Speed equal to your land Speed. If you already have a swim Speed, you gain a +10-foot status bonus to your swim Speed. When you use a single action to Sustain channel imperial dragon while within water, you can Swim up to 15 feet in a direction of your choice as part of your Sustain.

Tools of the Monsoon.name: Tools of the Monsoon
Tools of the Monsoon.description:
You gain access to a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.O7IZBvVoe7W2XnBa]{Machete}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.TDrO7Xdyn7juFy3c]{Kukri}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.DFtbWoL6yBnDbtB3]{Panabas} designed in Nagajor to cut down the dense thicket and mangroves. You have familiarity with those weapons. For the purposes of proficiency, you treat these weapons as simple weapons. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.c9fHUSI5lRdXu1Ic]{Feather Step} general feat even if you don’t meet the normal prerequisites.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.

A Study on Calamities.name: A Study on Calamities
A Study on Calamities.description: Your knowledge of myriad kaiju legends has proven itself applicable to any ritual, even those not originally meant to appease kaiju. You treat your degree of success on primary and secondary checks for rituals that would target kaiju or Gargantuan creatures as one step better. For the purposes of performing rituals that target kaiju, you reduce the number of secondary casters required by half your level (minimum 0). You learn the titan’s feud ritual.

Flirting With Danger.name: Flirting With Danger
Flirting With Danger.description:
Requirements You are flanked or within the melee reach of at least 3 enemies.

Nothing focuses the mind like mortal danger, and you’ve made a habit of diving into the middle of battles to give rise to your power. You gain an additional Focus Point until the end of your turn which can only be used to Energize a qi-shape action.

Sense Trouble.name: Sense Trouble
Sense Trouble.description: You have a preternatural ability to tell when the people you care about are in danger. During your daily preparations, select up to 6 creatures you are friends with. So long as you remain within a mile of them, you immediately sense when they are in danger. While they are in danger, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.JuqmIAnkL9hVGai8]{Hustle} at triple your movement speed, and have a vague sense of their location.

Share Breath.name: Share Breath
Share Breath.description:
You tie together the qi of you and your allies. Choose up to 3 willing creatures within 30 feet of you with whom to create a qi-bond. The qi-bond lasts for up to 1 minute or until they are no longer within 30 feet. A creature cannot be affected by more than one qi-bond at a time. When you form this bond, you can reduce your Hit Points by an amount up to your level to restore Hit Points to each qi-bonded ally of the same amount. On subsequent turns, you can Sustain this effect to restore Hit Points to one of your qi-bonded allies by reducing your Hit Points by an equal amount chosen at the time you Sustain the effect.

Energize Your allies gain twice the amount of restored Hit Points when you use Share Breath and when you Sustain the effect.

Tiger's Tail Stance.name: Tiger's Tail Stance
Tiger's Tail Stance.description:
Requirements You are wielding two hook swords.

With a single motion, you link two hook swords together, increasing your reach and filling onlookers with awe. You can Interact to link or unlink your swords, and may Interact to do so as a free action when entering the stance. You wield the linked hook swords as a single weapon in 1 hand and they gain the reach trait when wielded in this way. You are treated as wielding two hook swords while wielding linked hook swords and you cannot wield another weapon while wielding hook swords in this way. If your hook swords would have different runes or effects, you gain only the runes and effects of one of your swords which you choose when you first enter this stance.

Battle Mediation.name: Battle Mediation
Battle Mediation.description: In the heat of battle allows you can channel more qi than usual. While in this stance, the first time each turn you use Qi- Empowered Blows does not count towards your limit of one qi- shape per turn. In addition, the first time each turn you use a Focus Point for the Energize effect of Qi-Empowered Blows, you don’t expend a Focus Point.

Hongali Charge.name: Hongali Charge
Hongali Charge.description:
At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect. You can leverage the speed of your mount to add power to your shots. You Command your animal companion to Support and then Stride twice. It gains a +10-foot circumstance bonus to its Speed for these Strides.

Special If your animal companion has the Gallop activity, it can use Gallop instead of two Strides and it gains a +20-foot circumstance bonus to its Speed instead.

Sea Dragon Figurehead.name: Sea Dragon Figurehead
Sea Dragon Figurehead.description:
This ancient figurehead depicts a proud sea dragon emerging from crashing waves. Luong Phong’s child inspired many shipwrights in life. A constant cool breeze flows from it, reducing the temperature by one category on the ship’s deck behind it for 30 feet.

Activate—Tempest Roar 2 (aura, concentrate) Frequency once per hour

Effect The figurehead roars and creates a whirling tempest in an emanation with a distance equal to the ship’s length that remains active for 10 minutes. All terrain in the emanation is difficult terrain.

Activate—Tidal Boost 1 (manipulate, concentrate) Requirements The figurehead is generating a tempest around the ship

Effect You channel some of the tempest’s power into a tidal wave behind the ship, pushing it forward. The ship gains a +10-foot item bonus to its Speed for 1 round. At the start of your next turn, attempt a DC 28 piloting check to determine if you are able to continue riding the wave. On a success, the ship keeps its item bonus to its Speed and you can attempt the check again on the next round. On a failure, the wave passes the ship by and the item bonus ends.

Caretaker.name: Caretaker
Caretaker.description:
You spent many years creating a home to find solace in. You might have a family, or a group you have chosen to treat as such. You ensured all those under your roof could grow, thrive, and eventually follow their own dreams. And now it is time for you to do the same. Whether you are a retired adventurer called back to a life on the road, or someone who never dreamed of a life beyond the one you always knew, there is a whole wide world waiting for you out there.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Charisma or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in your choice of the Crafting skill, and gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.3HChkcD1IRqv4DbA]{Improvise Tool} skill feat or the Diplomacy skill and gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.6ON8DjFXSMITZleX]{No Cause for Alarm} skill feat. You’re trained in a Lore skill that is applicable to either your life at home or your dream.

Friendship of Dragon and Fish.name: Friendship of Dragon and Fish
Friendship of Dragon and Fish.description:
There is a Tian-Shu saying which describes the mingling of dragons and fish, an aphorism to describe the interactions between people of different status. You are a living expression of this proverb; serving a system that benefits the rich, yet the bulk of your dealings are with the poor. Every bandit you fight is just a reflection of yourself in another life, a version of yourself that fell into desperation and was driven to take rather than to serve. This empathy (and your reputation as a biaoshi) allows you to reduce chances of pointless conflict, even in the most unlikely of situations.

You become an expert in Survival. When you use Survival to Track criminals on the open road or in the wilderness, you also gain the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.plBGdZhqq5JBl1D8]{Gather Information}. Once per week, when you're in the wilderness or open road that has an established group of criminals, you can use Survival to Request a favor or aid from those people as if they were friendly to you. Your request must make sense for the criminals you are trying to contact. For instance, a leader of bandits might agree to allow safe passage through the area or a brigand might offer you a place to stay. If you critically succeed this check, your connection gives a piece of helpful advice or lets you in on a small secret, granting you or a member of your party a +2 circumstance bonus to the first skill check you attempt when acting on the favor. If you critically fail this check, you might have to perform some service for your connection to get back in their good graces, as determined by the GM.

Mobile Conducting.name: Mobile Conducting
Mobile Conducting.description:
Requirements You have a tang mai orchestration currently in effect.

You expand your knowledge of orchestrations. You move your 20-foot burst of spirit performers to another area within 30 feet.

Aolin's Voice.name: Aolin's Voice
Aolin's Voice.description: You speak with the subtle authority of an emperor who was written out of history, and others are more susceptible to your orders. While you’re channeling your dragon, a creature does not become temporarily immune to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.player-options.lys6uhEmeD7NUrXg]{Guile of a Soverign} until you fail your check against its Will DC.

Dance Among the Gods.name: Dance Among the Gods
Dance Among the Gods.description:
Requirements You've been in a Minatan dancer stance for at least 2 consecutive rounds.

Your movements build and build, your motions entranced, your body enraptured. In reverent reverie, you move to dance among the gods. You gain the effects of the avatar spell for as long as you remain in your stance. You can only choose a deity that is widely worshipped in Minata, such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.DEKKbg6riAdL2ARf]{Hei Feng} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.MbJ93Nw39h2cBYi5]{Lao Shu Po}, even if you do not worship them yourself.

prerequisites.value: Karenza Bladedancer Dedication or Maglalatik Dancer Dedication

Bearer of the Lantern.name: Bearer of the Lantern
Bearer of the Lantern.description: You have a lantern endowed by the Thousand-Souled Chorus to serve their most sacred role, carrying light and hope to those in need of your protection. You gain a lantern or similar illuminating object that you can hold in 1 hand. You can light or extinguish your lantern as a free action once each turn with nothing but a thought, which has the concentrate trait. The lantern shines bright light out to 20 feet and dim light out 20 feet further; this has the light, and magical traits (the counteract level against magical darkness is equal to half your level rounded up). You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.misc.MqxPoVbO4jirQfg4]{Protect the Meek} reaction.

The Power of Friendship.name: The Power of Friendship
The Power of Friendship.description:
Requirements You're in starlit sentinel form.

The very power of friendship itself can turn the tides of any fight, if you only believe. With all of your party members by your side, you can charge up a super-powered attack that will call on your allies and damage your foes in a blinding show of colors, lights, and the image of the spirit that guides you. You begin to float into the air up to 10 feet off the ground, charging up an almighty attack fueled by belief. You gain resistance 10 to all damage and your starlit sentinel form exudes bright light in a 10-foot emanation for 2 rounds.

For the duration, creatures can spend a single action with the concentrate trait to believe in your friendship with them, and they can use the action multiple times during the duration. Each time a character uses an action, you are empowered with a friendship counter, up to a maximum of 10 counters. Count the amount of times this action is performed before your next turn. You gain the All-Out Friendship Blast! activity.

Obscured From Kaiju.name: Obscured From Kaiju
Obscured From Kaiju.description:
You attempt to mask a location from the notice of Kaiju and similarly enormous creatures. This will cause them to unconsciously avoid it unless they are actively looking for something or someone within the area.
