Critical Success Kaiju and Gargantuan creatures unconsciously avoid the ritual area for 1 month. In addition, smaller creatures in the area gain a +4 status bonus to Stealth checks against Kaiju and Gargantuan creatures.

Success As critical success, except the status bonus is +2 and the duration is 1 week.

Failure You fail to mask the location from notice.

Second Soul.name: Second Soul
Second Soul.description:
Gain a second essence power for one of your soulforged armaments. When you manifest your armament, you choose which essence power to use. When using Manifest Soulforged Armament, you can spend 1 Mythic Point to utilize both of an armament’s essence powers.

Special You can take this feat up to three times, gaining a second essence power for a different Soulforged Armament each time.

Breath of the Imperial.name: Breath of the Imperial
Breath of the Imperial.description:
Requirements You’re channeling your dragon.

You channel your dragon’s element and exhale. You breath a @Template[type:cone|distance:30] that deals @Damage[(@actor.level)d6[@actor.flags.pf2e.imperialDragonEmissary.breathDamage]] with a @Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. Creatures that critically fail their save suffer the listed critical failure effect. The damage type depends on your dragon’s type, and this activity gains the corresponding tradition and damage trait of your imperial dragon. This damage increases by 1d6 for each level you possess.

Kaiju Caller Dedication.name: Kaiju Caller Dedication
Kaiju Caller Dedication.description:
Access Be taught by an existing Kaiju Caller or you have survived an encounter with a kaiju.

You have been inducted into the ranks of the kaiju callers and learned rituals enough to serve this role in the field. You gain the Additional Lore general feat for Kaiju Lore. You can use Kaiju Lore instead of Occultism or Religion for the primary check and secondary checks for rituals, so long as they would target a kaiju or an area a kaiju is present. You gain the Dance of the Kaiju Caller action.

Mouse and the Lion.name: Mouse and the Lion
Mouse and the Lion.description: Even the mightiest beast feels gratitude for aid rendered by the small. To render that aid is to invert the natural order of the world, and in doing so to take a small, compassionate measure of control over that world. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Medicine checks and to Recall Knowledge on Large or larger creatures. When you restore Hit Points to a Large or larger creature that is unfriendly or hostile towards you, the creature must attempt a Will save against your Medicine DC or it cannot take a hostile action against you or your allies for 1 round, or 1 minute on a critical failure. If you or your allies take a hostile action against the creature or its allies, it can take hostile actions against you and your allies again. Regardless of the result, the creature is temporarily immune for 1 day. This effect has the emotion, incapacitation, and mental traits. You learn the calm the torrent ritual.

Moss Cover (Greater).name: Moss Cover (Greater)
Moss Cover (Greater).description:
Activate 1 (Manipulate)

The moss mixed in this vial of oil is a hardy and fast-growing specimen taken from Arindham’s body. Applying this oil to yourself grants you 35 temporary Hit Points for 12 hours due to the moss cover on your body protecting you. The moss regrows if you don’t lose all temporary Hit Points, causing you to regain the original number of temporary Hit Points granted by applying the oil. This effect occurs one hour after you last took damage while the oil lasts.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.misc.Item.yW1V8GYB29XXhV0K]{Effect: Moss Cover (Greater)}

Shroud of Green.name: Shroud of Green
Shroud of Green.description: You shed a portion of your forest dragon’s power to reinvigorate the land as a primeval jungle. When you Sustain channel imperial dragon, you can choose to create plant-life in up to 4 contiguous squares within 30 feet of you. This plant life provides your choice of difficult terrain or an area of lesser cover

Dominance of Nature.name: Dominance of Nature
Dominance of Nature.description: You and your kami leverage your affinity with nature to seize control of a creature. Choose a creature with the animal, beast, elemental, or plant trait within 30 feet. The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled} by you for 1 round if its level is equal to or lower than your level – 3, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round. You can Sustain the effect on subsequent turns for up to 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns the creature has these conditions, it can attempt to end the effect by succeeding at a @Check[will|against:class-spell] saving throw against your class DC or spell DC (whichever is higher). Regardless of the result, the creature is temporarily immune to Dominance of Nature for 1 day.

Sword Dance.name: Sword Dance
Sword Dance.description:
Many Lingshen courtiers became Tiger Shepherds in the pursuit of furthering their standing. For them, the sword dance is at the heart of using hook swords, appealing as both martial and artistic in nature. When you Perform, if you are dancing, you can use hook swords to embellish the performance. You can add the weapon’s item bonus to attack rolls as an item bonus to checks to Perform with hook swords.

Additionally, hook swords are part of your performance so most people pay little attention to their presence. Hook swords you wield have the concealable trait and you can draw hook swords when you Perform with hook swords. You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.qVNVSmsgpKFGk9hV]{Conceal an Object} with your hook swords as part of your action to Perform, using your modifier for Perform on the check. When you make a Strike with a hook sword against a creature you concealed them from in a dance, they are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to your Strike. Once a creature has seen you use your hook swords as weapons, you cannot conceal your hook swords using Perform from that creature for 1 day.

Tiger's Fury.name: Tiger's Fury
Tiger's Fury.description:
Requirements You are wielding two hook swords.

You lash out at anything foolish enough to be within range. For each enemy within your melee reach, make a melee Strike or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} against it. Each attack counts toward your multiple attack penalty, but you do not increase your penalty until you have made all your attacks.

Toan Nguyen's Tincture.name: Toan Nguyen's Tincture
Toan Nguyen's Tincture.description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

This elixir comes in a brown glass bottle shaped like a taro root. The solution inside is cloudy, and a molted orchid mantis skin sits at the bottom of the bottle. After you drink this elixir, your hearing is enhanced to allow you to filter out background noise. You can eavesdrop on up to three ongoing conversations within 100 feet for 10 minutes without needing to make any checks to hear them in exchange for disabling one other precise sense of your choice for the duration. Your ears will be left ringing, making you deafened, for a number of minutes equal to the number of conversations you listened to after the tincture wears off.

Hive of Revenge.name: Hive of Revenge
Hive of Revenge.description:
Requirements You’re channeling your dragon.

You shed a portion of your forest dragon’s power to protect the land. You create a hive of insects on a surface within 30 feet of you. The hive has 0 Hardness and 1 Hit Point and doesn’t prevent creatures from occupying the space. It lasts for 1 minute before dissipating harmlessly, but if the hive takes damage or is destroyed, the hive attacks the creature that destroyed it so long as it is within 120 feet of the hive, dealing @Damage[(4+max(0,(ceil((@actor.level -15)/4))))d4[piercing],(4+max(0,(ceil((@actor.level -15)/4))))d4[poison]] damage with a basic @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|basic] against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. Creatures that critically fail their save are also sickened 2. At 16th level and then again at 20th level, the piercing and poison damage each increase by 1d6.

Fortify Others.name: Fortify Others
Fortify Others.description:
You use your ability to manipulate qi to bolster the life energy in another creature. Touch a creature within your melee reach and restore @Damage[(floor((max(1,@actor.level))/2))d4[healing]] Hit Points and the target gains a +1 status bonus to Fortitude saves for 1 round. The target is then temporarily immune to Fortify Others for 1 hour. At 8th level and every 2 levels thereafter, the Hit Points restored increases by 1d4.

Energize Your target can attempt a counteract check against that affliction or condition with a counteract modifier equal to your class DC – 10 or your spell attack modifier, whichever is higher. Your target can attempt to counteract only one affliction or condition each time you Fortify Others.

Void Worm's Experiment.name: Void Worm's Experiment
Void Worm's Experiment.description:
During the process of your creation, Laochong decided to imbue you with more than the usual necromantic magic. You have the void healing ability, which means you are harmed by vitality damage and healed by void effects as if you were undead. Replace your resistance to void damage with a resistance to vitality damage. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.mAMEt4FFbdqoRnkN]{Void Warp} as a divine innate spell. As normal, it is heightened to half your level rounded up.

Enhancement Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} as a divine innate spell with a rank heightened to half your level rounded up, but you must be the target or included in the effect of the spell.

I Am the Storm!.name: I Am the Storm!
I Am the Storm!.description:
Trigger You are the target of an electricity spell or effect.

Requirements You’re channeling your dragon.

You can consume the power of the storm, empowering yourself. You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} until the end of your next turn. You can use the extra action to Sustain channel imperial dragon, Stride, or for an action or activity you gained from this archetype.

Delve Into Mind.name: Delve Into Mind
Delve Into Mind.description:
Requirements Your last action dealt mental damage to your target and you’re channeling your dragon.

When you deal mental damage to a creature, you peer inside their mind and get a glimpse of the corners of their mind. You gain the effects of a successful Recall Knowledge against the creature and it must attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. Regardless of the outcome, the target is temporarily immune to Delve Into Nightmare for 1 day.

Critical Success The target pushes you out of their mind and is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.

Failure The target takes @Damage[@actor.level[persistent,mental]] damage equal to your level and is stupefied 1 until it recovers from the persistent mental damage.

Critical Failure As failure, except the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round and the target can’t recover from the persistent mental damage until it is no longer confused.

Kampilan.name: Kampilan
Kampilan.description: Due to the weight of the weapon, it is often carried across the shoulders and requires the other hand to be steady when making attacks.

Eto... Bleh!.name: Eto... Bleh!
Eto... Bleh!.description:
Requirements You're in sentinel form.

Your colorful outfit and pretty magic often leads to your foes underestimating you. With a cute flourish, you feign weakness, and cause them to drop their guard. Make a @Check[performance|against:perception] check against the Perception DC of a single creature that can see you. Regardless of the result, the target is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Critical Success Your opponent is filled with an arrogance you will punish. You gain a +1 status bonus to your AC and saves against the creature for 2 rounds. While under these effects, if the creature fails a Strike against you or you succeed at a save from an effect it created, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.misc.uKkq8NT2YUAgTj9M]{Effect: Eto... Bleh!}

Success As a success, but the effect lasts 1 round.

Failure The creature is unaffected.

Critical Failure You leave yourself open to attack. You are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} and stupefied 1 for 1 round.

Punishing Disarm.name: Punishing Disarm
Punishing Disarm.description:
Trigger You critically Disarmed an adjacent foe using a sai.

You hook your foe’s falling weapon and hurl it out of reach. Instead of dropping to the triggering creature’s space, the disarmed weapon lands in a square of your choice, up to 20 feet from you. The triggering creature is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} until the start of your next turn.

A Rising Tide, Raises all Ships.name: A Rising Tide, Raises all Ships
A Rising Tide, Raises all Ships.description:
You know the right words to rally your companions. Choose an ally within 30 feet affected by the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied} conditions and make a Diplomacy check against the DC of the effect that caused the condition. Regardless of the outcome, the target is temporarily immune to your attempts to use A Rising Tide, Raises All Ships for 1 day.

Critical Success The target reduces the value of a condition of its choice by 2.

Success As critical success, but the target reduces the value by 1.

Nature's Cradle.name: Nature's Cradle
Nature's Cradle.description: Your bond with a kami leads the natural world to protect you. You can attempt to Hide using Nature instead of Stealth when you are able to use foliage or natural surroundings for cover or concealment. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.misc.EdnmU1XpzwAobsQU]{Bestow Favor} reaction.

The Lurking Tiger.name: The Lurking Tiger
The Lurking Tiger.description: You wear marks of the tiger and skulk your foes. If you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to an enemy, you can reveal yourself as part of a Demoralize to gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your check.

Maglalatik Armor.name: Maglalatik Armor
Maglalatik Armor.description: This armor is constructed of large numbers of coconut shells woven together into a patterned suit which displaces enemy blows and protects the wearer.

Pham Lê Ngọc's Ceremonial Sword (Major).name: Pham Lê Ngọc's Ceremonial Sword (Major)
Pham Lê Ngọc's Ceremonial Sword (Major).description:
This +3 greater striking greater astral shifting standard-grade cold iron liuyedao comes in an intricately ornamented scabbard covered with designs of imperial dragons. In addition to its ability to shift into different weapon types, the blade and scabbard can transform their appearance to pass as official ceremonial swords of any nation the wielder has seen, granting a +3 item bonus to Deception checks to pass as a diplomat of that nation. The blade may also be allowed in areas where weapons are otherwise banned, at the GM’s discretion, due to its function as a diplomatic status symbol.

Activate—Focused Attack 2 (concentrate, flourish, manipulate) Requirements You haven't attacked your target today

Effect You have one chance to take out a target. Make a Strike. Your outcome is one degree of success better than what you rolled. If the outcome was already a critical success, your target takes an additional @Damage[6d6[precision]]{6d6 precision} damage.

Censor Methodology.name: Censor Methodology
Censor Methodology.description: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.JtjnFsOToBLnSRO9]{Courtly Graces} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.WeQGWvlWdeLeOlCN]{Glean Contents} skill feats. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.d9gbpiQjChYDYA2L]{Decipher Writing} you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.xTK2zsWFyxSJvYbX]{Pursue a Lead} as part of the same activity if you would discover something of interest. This need not be the contents of the document, but can be related to its composition, handwriting, or other subject matter. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.misc.jtAILwSlLZIpjB9g]{Proclamation of Authority} activity.

Pham Lê Ngọc's Ceremonial Sword (True).name: Pham Lê Ngọc's Ceremonial Sword (True)
Pham Lê Ngọc's Ceremonial Sword (True).description:
This +3 major striking greater astral greater brilliant shifting high-grade cold iron liuyedao comes in an intricately ornamented scabbard covered with designs of imperial dragons. In addition to its ability to shift into different weapon types, the blade and scabbard can transform their appearance to pass as official ceremonial swords of any nation the wielder has seen, granting a +4 item bonus to Deception checks to pass as a diplomat of that nation. The blade may also be allowed in areas where weapons are otherwise banned, at the GM’s discretion, due to its function as a diplomatic status symbol.

Activate—Focused Attack 2 (concentrate, flourish, manipulate) Requirements You haven't attacked your target today

Effect You have one chance to take out a target. Make a Strike. Your outcome is one degree of success better than what you rolled. If the outcome was already a critical success, your target takes an additional @Damage[8d6[precision]]{8d6 precision} damage.

White Tiger Kinship.name: White Tiger Kinship
White Tiger Kinship.description: You have a certain understanding, like a shared language, with most felines.You are permanently under the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.BBvV7qoXGdw09q1C]{Speak with Animals}, but only for cats, big and small. Due to your connection to the White Tiger, most big cats are likely to be friendly with you, unless they have a grudge against Baekho or are associated with another deity. In addition, once per day you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.wp09USMB3GIW1qbp]{Animal Form} as an divine innate spell heightened to a rank equal to half your level rounded up, but you can only select the cat form. While in this form, your unarmed attacks count as hook swords for the purposes of using feats or actions granted by this archetype provided they would not require the physical length or make of a hook sword, such as Tiger’s Tail Stance (subject to GM discretion).

Destabilizing Guard.name: Destabilizing Guard
Destabilizing Guard.description:
Requirements You are wielding at least one sai.

You lash out at incoming attacks, battering them aside before they can harm you. Designate a target creature. Until the start of your next turn, you may use your reaction to use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.misc.9NExELQfZW76vMpY]{Disrupting Riposte} action.

Feed on Metal.name: Feed on Metal
Feed on Metal.description:
Trigger You take damage from a weapon made primarily of metal or affected by a spell with the metal trait.

Requirements You’re channeling your dragon.

Your skin hardens in the face of metal, altering to help protect. You gain a +1 item bonus to AC or increase your item bonus to AC by 1 until the end of your next turn.

Shared Prescience.name: Shared Prescience
Shared Prescience.description: Experience allows you to analyze visions from your sky dragon to view many possible futures and determine the best course for all your allies against your target. Up to 6 allies within 60 feet of you gain the effects of your Precognition.

Precognition.name: Precognition
Precognition.description:
Trigger You Cast channel imperial dragon.

You focus on a foe, predicting their next moves. Choose an enemy you can see, learning its weakest save. The target takes a –1 status penalty on these saves against you while you’re channeling your dragon. After channel imperial dragon has been Sustained thrice, the status penalty increases to –2.

Verse of Triumph.name: Verse of Triumph
Verse of Triumph.description:
Your orchestra plays a song that imbues your allies with the most devastating blows to leave the enemy reeling.

Expert When your allies successfully critically Strike an enemy, the enemy becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 round.

Master As expert, except the duration is 2 rounds.

Legendary As master, except the enemy is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} for 3 rounds.

Tiger's Mirage.name: Tiger's Mirage
Tiger's Mirage.description: You leave behind the image of a harmless shepherd, only to be the tiger stalking in the shadows. You create an illusionary replica of yourself that appears in your space that lasts for 1 minute. You also gain the concealed condition as long as your illusion remains or until after you take a hostile action, whichever comes first. If the illusion is interacted with or attacked, it immediately disappears.

Guile of a Soverign.name: Guile of a Soverign
Guile of a Soverign.description:
You’ve proven you can keep up with the mental dexterity of even the shrewdest sovereign dragon, and your sharp tongue is as fearsome as any weapon you bear. You can attempt to confound an enemy using your guile. Make a @Check[diplomacy|against:will] check against the Will DC of one creature you can see, attempting to convince them to either approach you, pick up an adjacent object, respond to you with a specific statement, run away (as if it had the fleeing condition), or stand in place. Usually, if a creature is at least friendly to you, they will follow your direction and not consider this a hostile action. Regardless of the result, the creature is temporarily immune for 1 day.

Critical Success The creature takes a –2 status penalty to attack rolls or skill checks, unless they pertain to the action you chose for 1 round. Spending an action to do the chosen task ends this effect.

Success As critical success, except the status penalty is –1.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.misc.fCBcMJtK8er70c86]{Effect: Guile of a Soverign}

Hidden Operative.name: Hidden Operative
Hidden Operative.description: Sometimes serving a sovereign dragon requires the utmost secrecy. You gain the ability to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.I0j56TNRmGcTyoqJ]{Shared Invisibility} as an occult innate 5th-rank spell once per day.

Arindham's Whip (Greater).name: Arindham's Whip (Greater)
Arindham's Whip (Greater).description:
This leathery, moss-covered +2 greater striking rooting whip is made from a petrified lizardfolk’s tongue, gnarled peachwood and Arindham’s whiskers. Foes who are bioengineered, artificial, or corrupted in some way, including but not limited to creatures with the aberration, construct, and undead traits, are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to you while they are immobilized by the whip’s rooting rune. You can use the following action when holding the whip.

Activate—Crack of the Vine 1 (manipulate) Frequency once per hour

Effect For 1 round, razor-sharp thorns cover Arindham’s whip—it loses the nonlethal trait and attacks also deal @Damage[2d4[bleed]] damage.

Entangling Flurry.name: Entangling Flurry
Entangling Flurry.description:
Requirements You are wielding at least one sai.

Your flurry grabs weapons and foes with equal ease. You can replace one or both of your attacks during a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.nbfNETdpee8CVM17]{Flurry of Blows} with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarms}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapples}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Repositions}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trips}.

Terra-Cotta Automaton Heritage.name: Terra-Cotta Automaton Heritage
Terra-Cotta Automaton Heritage.description:
Lingshen’s military is renowned for its discipline, tradition, and pride. But the most notable aspect for those outside the kingdom’s borders is their Terra-cotta soldiers. Each soldier who served in the army knows that upon death, they shall once more join their brothers and sisters in arms. This is the proof of Lingshen’s dominance and right as true inheritor to Imperial Lung Wa. This is the cost of service to the crown.

As a Terra-cotta Automaton, you were reanimated by the Old Worm of Lingshen. You gain resistance to void damage equal to half your level (minimum 1).

Secure.name: Secure
Secure.description:
Above all else, you must defend your cargo. If it is a person, you must keep them at ease. If it is a convoy, you must keep it from harm. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.misc.4sDxSmAuYZxoB72x]{Secure Convoy} action.

Masterful Hunter Upgrade

You do your bloody-handed work for a living, and know any bandits who covet your wards are just doing the same. Robbery and plunder is how you eke out a living, and only a fool would refuse to acknowledge this. You increase your convoy’s circumstance bonus to AC and saves against your prey to a +2 circumstance bonus and the bonuses to Perception checks to Seek your convoy and Survival checks to track your convoy increase to +4.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.misc.MoHTtWVjq0oE0Rd8]{Effect: Masterful Ranger's Convoy}

A Humble Voice Amongst the Thousand.name: A Humble Voice Amongst the Thousand
A Humble Voice Amongst the Thousand.description: The song of Phi Deva overwhelms your physical form and you are subsumed into the multitudes of the one and thousand alike. You become one of the flock in earnest, the rhythm of strife and creation are now yours to see. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.player-options.BHt7Adf0Ew6zrw4D]{Bird's Eye View} focus spell.

Qi Buffer.name: Qi Buffer
Qi Buffer.description:
Trigger You attempt a Fortitude saving throw, but you haven’t rolled yet.

Your mastery of energy allows you to redirect its flow away from your body. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your save.

Energize You may attempt the triggering save twice and use the better result. This is a fortune effect.

Inquisitive Eye.name: Inquisitive Eye
Inquisitive Eye.description: You’ve developed a technique for forming a magical eye to help you investigate items. You become trained in your choice of Arcana or Occultism and gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.OhD2Z6rIGGD5ocZA]{Read Aura} as an arcane or occult innate cantrip, depending on your choice. Additionally, if the target of your read aura cantrip is related to your tsukumogami poppet heritage Lore skill, you gain a +3 circumstance bonus to Identify Magic instead of a +2.

Reopen Cold Case.name: Reopen Cold Case
Reopen Cold Case.description:
Requirements You have a writing set and a place to write.

You write and reflect on your observations, intuitions, hypotheses, and biases, you may create a set of archival records. Choose an investigation you currently have open and spend 10 minutes to document it as a cold case and give up pursuit on it. You can only have one cold case at a time. Whenever you encounter a clue related to your cold case, your GM immediately attempts a secret Perception check for you to discover it. When you encounter a clue from a cold case, you can choose to make it one of your leads even though you stopped following the cold case, and you can change back to your cold case any number of times by using a single action, which has the concentrate trait.

Deluge Redirection.name: Deluge Redirection
Deluge Redirection.description: You have attuned yourself to the river’s currents to the point where you can redirect its flow. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.zfn5RqAdF63neqpP]{Control Water} as a primal innate spell. When you cast the spell you can adjust the flow and speed of the water in addition to the normal effects and can choose to make water you target into normal terrain or difficult terrain.

Spine-Chilling Violence.name: Spine-Chilling Violence
Spine-Chilling Violence.description: Your critical hits unnerve your foes. When you critically hit an enemy and deal damage, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}. Additionally, if the creature was temporarily immune to your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.tXn6fJO3Q2dAvCZC]{Sudden Terror}, they lose their temporary immunity.

Sword Qi Wave (QYAu).name: Sword Qi Wave
Sword Qi Wave (QYAu).description: You gather qi in your weapon or hand, unleashing it in a cone of devastating energy with a slash. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.player-options.cRnnxbFQLUzvgnPG]{Sword Qi Wave} cultivator focus spell.

Fighting Retreat.name: Fighting Retreat
Fighting Retreat.description:
Requirements You are mounted.

You have mastered the dreaded hit-and-run tactic of Hongali horse lords, shooting at an enemy while galloping away from them at full speed or suddenly turning to attack. You Command your mount to Stride twice and you Strike with a weapon in the bow weapon group at any point during these Strides. You ignore the penalty for making ranged attacks within your second range increment for this Strike. If your mount has the Gallop activity, you can Command your mount to Gallop instead of Striding twice. Strides made as part of Fighting Retreat don’t trigger reactions.

Round Barrage.name: Round Barrage
Round Barrage.description:
Requirements You are wielding two Minatan weapons with the twin trait.

You deliver a wave of blows, each attack setting up another. Make three melee Strikes. Each attack counts towards your multiple attack penalty, but doesn’t increase your penalty until you have made all three attacks. The first time you apply the twin weapon circumstance bonus to damage during this attack, increase it by +1. The second time you apply it, increase it by +4.

Weaving Stance.name: Weaving Stance
Weaving Stance.description:
Requirements You are wielding two Minatan weapons.

Your weapons weave through the air in front of you, creating endless openings for you to exploit. Your weapons gain the twin trait if they don’t already have it, even if they’re not the same weapon type. When an opponent within your reach fails a Strike against you, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your next melee weapon attack against them before the end of your next turn.

Master of Garments.name: Master of Garments
Master of Garments.description:
You have devoted your life to the understanding of garments. Patterns reveal themselves in the patterns people garb themselves in, from casual wear to ceremonial finery, to understand the cloth is to understand the person. To understand what they wish to project, the stories they tell themselves, the hopes they wish others perceive in them. Despite ceaseless hours of dedication to your craft, you know there is so much more for you to learn. You could secure a comfortable life as a humble tailor, but you yearn for a greater truth.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Charisma or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost.

You are trained in the Crafting skill and the Fashion Lore skill. When you use Fashion Lore to Earn Income, you can treat the level of the task as 2 higher than normal by pioneering a new fashion design. If the task is 20th level, you gain the effects of a critical success when you roll a success.

Ant's Steps.name: Ant's Steps
Ant's Steps.description: When titans march to war, the ant’s only defense is to be beneath notice. You are an expert at evading the senses of larger creatures. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.IJQJBnD5CjKvFYEx]{Foil Senses} skill feat and a +2 circumstance bonus to your Stealth checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.IE2nThCmoyhQA0Jn]{Avoid Notice}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} actions against Large or larger creatures. Whenever you use the Avoid Notice, Hide, or Sneak actions, you are always considered to be taking precautions against special senses from these creatures. You learn the obscured from kaiju ritual.

Barong.name: Barong
Barong.description: This sword, which can vary in length and is particularly heavy, allows subsequent swings to be quite deadly due to the fan of the blade carrying the blows.

Entwined Destiny.name: Entwined Destiny
Entwined Destiny.description: As your mutual destiny grows closer, your kami further empowers you for what lies ahead. Your kami’s energy when you use an action or activity that requires its assistance is only depleted for 10 minutes instead of 1 hour. In addition, once per day you can call on your kami to assist you when its energy is depleted.

Coconut Shell.name: Coconut Shell
Coconut Shell.description: Small coconut shells that serve as effective bludgeoning tools.

Intimidating Channel.name: Intimidating Channel
Intimidating Channel.description: The dragon essence infused into your presence is intimidating enough to make foes hesitate. You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.player-options.V3GVl8DGAwp8HvOK]{Channel Imperial Dragon} and then can immediately attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} a foe.

Fumeiyoshi (Prince of the Night).name: Fumeiyoshi (Prince of the Night)
Fumeiyoshi (Prince of the Night).description:
There was a time where Fumeiyoshi was more than some child’s cautionary tale, where he was a beloved prince of the night. The Prince of Night watched over the people of Tian Xia and beckoned them to rest. Worship of the Fumeiyoshi that existed before his betrayal has waned in numbers, but many still find comfort in what once was. Offerings of incense and alcohol to the Prince of Night can be found on street corners, brothels, or docks. Those who work into the late hours or who seek acknowledgement in any form will find that the night remembers even if the Prince has long forgotten.

Title Prince of Night

Areas of Concern the night, the lonely, resting

Edicts Take in the beauty of the night, encourage rest after a day of work, seek comfort in the darkness.

Anathema Waste alcohol and food, discriminate against sex workers, travel without proper rest

Disaster Sense.name: Disaster Sense
Disaster Sense.description: Through training and experience, you are attuned to the skies and the river currents, allowing you to predict impending disaster. Concentrating on weather patterns for at least 10 minutes, you gain the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.41TZEjhO6D1nWw2X]{Augury}, except you learn only about the weather for the next day. Any results of “good” are instead “clear skies,” “mixed” are instead “overcast or light rain”, and “bad” are instead “disaster”. You grant yourself and up to 6 allies a +2 status bonus to saves against any effects you predicted for 1 day.

Underworld Cognition.name: Underworld Cognition
Underworld Cognition.description: Geojibom promised you the secret to traversing through even the darkest cracks of the earth. You gain tremorsense as an imprecise sense with a range of 15 feet and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception checks that rely on hearing. While you’re channeling your dragon, the range of your tremorsense grows to 30 feet and the circumstance bonus increases to +2.

Hoardseeker.name: Hoardseeker
Hoardseeker.description: You’re known to work for a dragon who covets treasure and isn’t afraid to use force to acquire more. When @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.plBGdZhqq5JBl1D8]{Gathering Information} about something classified as treasure or a treasure hoard, you can use Intimidation for the check. Your outcome is one degree of success better than you rolled, but every creature you encountered during the activity responds as though you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.tHCqgwjtQtzNqVvd]{Coerced} them, with the original outcome of your Gather Information roll determining their behavior and attitude after being Coerced.

Serpent of the Earth.name: Serpent of the Earth
Serpent of the Earth.description: You can move through the earth as easily as your benefactor. When you spend a single action to Sustain your channel imperial dragon, you can also Burrow up to 15 feet if you are standing on earth or ground.

Riving Gnash.name: Riving Gnash
Riving Gnash.description:
Requirements You are wielding two hook swords.

You tear into the opponent’s flesh using the pointed tip of the hook. Make two melee Strikes against a creature within reach with the required weapons. Your multiple attack penalty applies as normal. For these Strikes, your hook swords deal piercing damage instead of slashing damage, and if both Strikes hit, the creature takes @Damage[(floor(@self.level/2))[bleed]] equal to half your level.

Sorrow of the Sea Dragon.name: Sorrow of the Sea Dragon
Sorrow of the Sea Dragon.description:
Requirements You’re channeling your dragon.

You use the power of your sea dragon to create a miniature hurricane. Choose a spot within 30 feet to conjure a 15-foot cube of raging winds and rain that lasts as long as you are channeling your dragon. The area becomes difficult terrain or greater difficult terrain for creatures that attempt to Fly through the area. Creatures other than you that end their turn within the area take @Damage[4d8[bludgeoning]] damage with a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|basic] save. When you Sustain channel imperial dragon, you can move the area to another 15-foot cube within 30 feet.

Mythic Manifestation.name: Mythic Manifestation
Mythic Manifestation.description: You can spend up to 3 Mythic Points per day to manifest your soulforged armament’s essence form additional times.

Tiger Shepherd Dedication.name: Tiger Shepherd Dedication
Tiger Shepherd Dedication.description: You have the title of Tiger Shepherd, a devotee of the hook sword. For the purposes of proficiency, you treat hook swords as martial weapons.You gain the Shepherd’s Claws free action.

Feed on Water.name: Feed on Water
Feed on Water.description:
Trigger You take damage from a water spell or effect.

Requirements You’re channeling your imperial dragon.

Your body is invigorated as the water is absorbed into your channeling. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level that last for as long as you are channeling your dragon.

Calm the Torrent.name: Calm the Torrent
Calm the Torrent.description:
You attempt to stifle the monstrous wrath of a Kaiju you are aware of, ending its rampage. More powerful goads, like the theft or desecration of an object important to the Kaiju, may cause the Kaiju to restart its rampage shortly if the offense is not rectified.

Critical Success The Kaiju’s rampage ends immediately and cannot restart for 1 hour. You learn, in detail, any factors aggravating the Kaiju.

Success The Kaiju’s rampage ends immediately and cannot restart for 10 minutes. You learn, in one-word descriptions, any factors aggravating the Kaiju.

Failure You fail to stop the Kaiju’s rampage.

Critical Failure The Kaiju is angry with you, personally, for 1d4 hours and will take hostile actions against you instead of others unless it is attacked or threatened during this time.

Diplomatic Immunity.name: Diplomatic Immunity
Diplomatic Immunity.description:
Trigger You gain temporary immunity to an effect while channeling your imperial dragon.

As a dragon’s emissary, you share your benefits with your allies. Adjacent allies are also temporarily immune to the same effect with the same duration.

Confident Courage.name: Confident Courage
Confident Courage.description: Your bravery is supernatural while in your sentinel form, even if you are usually a little meek. While in sentinel form, you have a +1 status bonus to saves against emotion effects and anytime you gain the frightened condition, reduce its value by 1.

Clay Steed.name: Clay Steed
Clay Steed.description:
When you served in the Lingshen military, you brought a steed you fought atop. As a soldier, it, too, was remade as a Terra-cotta automaton. You can cast 3rd-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.WPKJOhEihhcIm2uQ]{Marvelous Mount} as an divine innate spell once per day.

Enhancement Your marvelous mount is heightened to 5th rank and can be cast once per hour instead of once per day.

Precise Pressure.name: Precise Pressure
Precise Pressure.description:
You have honed your focus such that you can map the body of an opponent and identify key pressure points to hit. You use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.misc.38Ks1K36sOWumo2f]{Qi-Empowered Blows} and make a single Strike against a target. The additional damage on this Strike from your Qi-Empowered Blows is doubled and if you hit the target, it must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. This counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the end of your next turn.

Critical Failure As failure, except the target is enfeebled 2.

Energize The enfeebled condition lasts for 1 minute instead of until the end of your next turn.

Geojibom's Greatpick (Greater).name: Geojibom's Greatpick (Greater)
Geojibom's Greatpick (Greater).description:
This pitch black +1 flaming striking greatpick is made from alloys of reinforced metals forged by Geojibom’s breath. On a critical hit, the force of the greatpick’s impact unleashes a fiery explosion that deals @Damage[3d6[fire]] damage to all creatures within 10 feet of your target except for yourself with a @Check[reflex|dc:25|basic] save. Creatures who critically fail their save are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled}for 1 round.

Activate—Cast a Spell

Effect You cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.vJZ83ehQiM906lea]{Detect Metal} cantrip. In addition to metal, you are also aware of gemstones and other precious materials that are naturally occurring in earth and would be considered valuable treasure by an underworld dragon.

Feed on Earth.name: Feed on Earth
Feed on Earth.description:
Trigger You take damage from an earth spell or effect.

Requirements You’re channeling your imperial dragon.

Gravel and dust surrounds you when you move. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealement} during move actions until the end of your next turn.

Emissary of Fire.name: Emissary of Fire
Emissary of Fire.description: Your exposure to your underworld dragon’s fiery nature has granted you mastery of the element. You gain fire resistance equal to your level and while you’re channeling your dragon, you are immune to fire damage and effects with the fire trait.

Cart Puller.name: Cart Puller
Cart Puller.description:
You toiled for coin as a cart-bearer, straining your muscles for what meager coins your efforts would earn you. Whether pulling or cycling a cart, or carrying a litter pole on your shoulders, the reward was never enough for the costs it took on you. Many in your line of work were street rats and orphans, or the only ones old enough to earn money for their families. Forced to rely on your strength and the petty coppers of those you carried to get by, you've grown tired of this life of servitude. Desperation or too many tales overheard from passengers have put you on the path of an adventurer.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Dexterity, and one is a free attribute boost.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Dexterity, and one is a free attribute boost.You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Urban Terrain Lore skill. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.C0Tcelg3BAPhML6J]{Hefty Hauler} skill feat.

Sky Dragon's Eyes (Moderate).name: Sky Dragon's Eyes (Moderate)
Sky Dragon's Eyes (Moderate).description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

These pale cheese curd balls resemble the eyes of sky dragons and taste light and airy. After you eat this cheese curd, you gain a sky dragon’s mist vision for the listed duration—fog and mist don’t impair your vision; ignore the concealed condition from fog and mist for 1 hour.

Tears of Shizuru.name: Tears of Shizuru
Tears of Shizuru.description:
Legend has it Shizuru’s tears mixed with the blood of her lover and the Prince of the Moon, Tsukiyo, to form the sacred jade ore that makes up most of the mountainous region of Zi Ha. This amulet consists of six pieces of Tsukiyo jade and is divinely blessed by Shei Long and Shizuru to protect the wearer from death.

Activate f (divine) Trigger You drop to 0 Hit Points but do not immediately die

Effect The amulet shatters and is destroyed. Jade tears start falling from the sky in a 30-foot radius around you. Upon activation and at the start of your turn for the next 2 rounds, the tears deal @Damage[3d8[force]] damage to all enemies in the area with a @Check[fortitude|dc:35|basic] save. The tears have the holy trait. At the same time, all allies in the area are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened}. They can use this extra action only to move or use an action with a healing effect.

Lesson of Recurrence.name: Lesson of Recurrence
Lesson of Recurrence.description:
Your kami has instilled in you the importance of introspection, space and time. By spending one hour in continuous meditation you leave an imprint of your soul in your current space. You may only have one imprint of your soul active at a time, and creating a new imprint causes the previous one to fade.

You can call on your kami to assist you while you have an imprint active, allowing you to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.69L70wKfGDY66Mk9]{Teleport} of a rank heightened to half your level rounded up. You must select the location of your imprint as the destination of your teleport.

Transfer Expert.name: Transfer Expert
Transfer Expert.description: You’ve become more efficient with disaster relief and providing aid to those in need even when dangers become more perilous and supplies are low. Increase your maximum and encumbered Bulk limits by 1 and you reduce the Bulk of other creatures you carry by 1. In addition, when you are in water deep enough that you could normally float in it, you are not affected by the encumbered condition.

Verse of Preparation.name: Verse of Preparation
Verse of Preparation.description:
Your orchestra plays the opening set of a song used to prepare warriors for a spar.

Expert Allies who heard the song gain temporary Hit Points equal to half your level.

Master As expert, except the temporary Hit Points are equal to 5 plus half your level.

Legendary As expert, except the temporary Hit Points are equal to 10 plus half your level.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.misc.Item.ra9yO8jRitIxWtVd]{Effect: Verse of Preparation}

Stone Bonsai.name: Stone Bonsai
Stone Bonsai.description:
Activate 1 (Manipulate)

Geojibom has popularized these stone tree sculptures in the Darklands, often sending them as housewarming gifts or as respectful tokens to neighboring factions so as to remind them of where her territory begins. They reach toward the sun as if naturally planted trees. Occasionally, the branches shudder. You can propagate them by breaking off a branch and planting it. You can Activate it by watering it, causing the stone bonsai to grow 1 foot for each quart of water received, up to a maximum height of 20 feet.

Inner Peace.name: Inner Peace
Inner Peace.description: As the kami’s body, your kami has an interest in keeping you centered. When you use an action or activity you gained from this archetype, you can attempt to counteract one of the following conditions on yourself by attempting a Nature check against the DC that caused the effect: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied}.

Titan's Feud.name: Titan's Feud
Titan's Feud.description:
You attempt to call a Kaiju to the defense of an area against other nearby Kaiju. If you target more than one kaiju, increase the DC of this ritual by 5 for each additional kaiju.

Critical Success The targeted kaiju approaches the location of the casting and remains in the area for 1 week. Each targeted Kaiju claims the area as its territory, and will fight other Kaiju it perceives that enters the area.

Success As critical success, except the duration the kaiju approach and fight is 1 day instead of 1 week.

Failure You fail to call any Kaiju to the area.

Critical Failure All targeted Kaiju are hostile towards all participants and seek to destroy them for 1 day.

Poison Taster.name: Poison Taster
Poison Taster.description:
You have served a perilous role in the company of alchemists and nobles. You are a poison taster, someone who tests substances by consuming, imbibing, or otherwise swallowing them down while others watch. Many perish on the job, but so far, you’ve survived. You could’ve spent your entire life training your body and building your tolerance or it could be natural born resistance. Poison is an acquired taste and you are accustomed to it.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Constitution, and one is a free attribute boost.

You are trained in your choice of the Medicine skill or the Survival skill. You gain a +1 status bonus to saves against poisons. Additionally, when you successfully save to remove a poison you increase your status bonus against that poison to +2 for 1 day.

Ant Pheromones.name: Ant Pheromones
Ant Pheromones.description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

This vial contains potent pheromones that compels ants in the area to swarm out of the ground and attack. You throw the vial at a spot on the ground within 30 feet when you Activate it, causing an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.drcSWbCIWc7P4lKO]{Army Ant Swarm} to appear in the area, centered on the spot, at the end of the round. The swarm immediately takes its turn at the end of the initiative order to attack all creatures in its area. If there are no creatures in its area, the swarm dissipates at the end of its turn. Otherwise, the swarm remains in the same spot for 3 rounds unless destroyed sooner.

Luong Phung's Trident.name: Luong Phung's Trident
Luong Phung's Trident.description:
This elegant steel +1 striking returning trident is coated with scales that Luong Phung has shed throughout the years. The shaft is cool and soothing to touch, like gentle waves gliding over your hand.

Activate—Ring Tines 2 (manipulate, sonic) Frequency once per day

Effect Each creature within 15 feet takes @Damage[2d10[sonic]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:19|basic] save). Any creature that fails is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 round, or 1 hour on a critical failure.

Mole Mine (Greater).name: Mole Mine (Greater)
Mole Mine (Greater).description:
Activate 1 (Manipulate)

This device looks like a very large mole but is a magical wooden construct. It must be placed on soil or ground when Activated, whereupon it burrows just under the surface of the ground 30 feet in a direction of your choice and ends its movement in a single 5-foot square, leaving no tunnels or signs of its passing. For up to 1 minute, if a creature moves on the ground within 5- foot emanation of the mole mine, it immediately resurfaces near the creature and explodes, dealing @Damage[4d6[fire],4[persistent,fire]]damage (@Check[reflex|dc:37|basic]) to all creatures in a 5-foot burst centered on the corner of the creature closest to the bomb that moved through the area.

Chest Compressions.name: Chest Compressions
Chest Compressions.description:
You know the moments after the loss of oxygen are critical. When you use Battle Medicine against a creature that gained the unconscious condition from suffocation, you restore twice the number of Hit Points on a successful check (quadruple the amount of critical success).

In addition, you can use Battle Medicine to revive a creature that died within the last minute from suffocation by attempting a Medicine check against a DC 30. The DC increases by 1 for each round that passes after the creature died from suffocating. If you succeed, the target returns to life with the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.IkGYwHRLhkuoGReG]{Raise Dead}, except it still has the wounded condition it had before dying, increased by 1 (or wounded 1 if it wasn’t wounded before dying). The creature must be able to breathe in its current environment or your check automatically fails.

Phial of Zhulong (Lesser).name: Phial of Zhulong (Lesser)
Phial of Zhulong (Lesser).description:
Activate A Strike

This sphere of glass is filled with two separate liquids, a sickly yellow oil and the lurid green distilled saliva of an underworld dragon. It explodes into acrid sparks when shaken and thrown. Developed by the young underworld dragon Zhulong in their plan to siege the kishin oni Inma’s fortress, it is more damaging to objects than creatures. A phial of Zhulong deals the 1 acid damage and 1d4 persistent acid damage, but it deals double damage to inanimate objects that are not being held. Inanimate mundane objects that receive double damage also have their Hardness permanently reduced by 1 each time they are hit—if their Hardness would be reduced to less than 0, they gain a weakness to acid and fire damage equal to 1 or increase these values by 1 if they already had a weakness. Flammable objects within 5 feet of the bomb’s target immediately catch on fire, taking 1d4 fire damage each round until extinguished, regardless of the outcome of the bomb’s attack roll. Many types grant an item bonus to attack rolls.

Burning Coils.name: Burning Coils
Burning Coils.description:
Requirements You’re channeling your dragon.

You summon the fiery spiritual form of an underworld dragon. Its body coils around you, creating a 5-foot-thick fire wall in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:15] around you. The wall lasts until you move, until you stop channeling your dragon, or you Dismiss it. Everything on each side of the wall is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} from creatures on the opposite side. Any creature that crosses the wall or is occupying the wall’s area at the start of its turn takes @Damage[(4+max(0,(ceil((@actor.level -11)/2))))d6[fire]] damage. At 12th level, and every two levels thereafter, increase the fire damage by 1d6.

Breath of Righteousness.name: Breath of Righteousness
Breath of Righteousness.description:
You dedicate yourself to justice, seeking the betterment of mortal condition for the ordinary masses regardless of circumstance or background. As a warrior-scholar, you disdain the aloof Heavens and unclean spirits both, putting what’s good for the people over ineffable cosmic laws.

Your very being burns otherworldly intruders and dark spirits like fire. You can use Occultism to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive}, and when someone tries to Lie to you, use your Occultism DC if it is higher than your Perception DC to determine whether they succeed, as your eyes discern the lies with supernatural accuracy.

Your Strikes and cultivator spells count as holy, spirit, or unholy for purposes of triggering holy, spirit, or unholy weaknesses and weapons you wield and your unarmed attacks gain the effects of the ghost touch property rune. You gain a weakness to both holy and unholy damage equal to half your level.

Lastly, you gain the following edict. If you ever fail to follow this edict or gain the holy or unholy trait, you lose the effects of this feat until you are no longer holy or unholy and have performed the atone ritual.

Edict Provide a peaceful and autonomous society in which the people are cared for through social infrastructure

Morphing Snare.name: Morphing Snare
Morphing Snare.description:
Requirements You have a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}.

You continuously contort your body around your foe, making it difficult to speak. Make an unarmed melee Strike against the grabbed foe. On a success, the target is muffled until the start of your next turn or until it Escapes, whichever comes first. While the target is muffled, its speech is no louder than a whisper, and it must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:10] or lose any action that requires speech. For actions requiring speech and a manipulate action, the target just rolls a single DC 10 flat check, instead of an additional one for being grabbed.

Dreadnought Slam.name: Dreadnought Slam
Dreadnought Slam.description:
Using your greater weight to your advantage, you can knock a creature off balance with a painful slam. Make a melee unarmed Strike. If it hits and deals damage, you can attempt an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} the creature you hit. Both attacks count toward your multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn’t increase until after you’ve made both of them.

Enhancement Your slam staggers flying creatures. On a hit against a flying creature, the creature must attempt a @Check[reflex|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. Creatures that fail their save fall 20 feet (or 40 feet on a critical failure).

Special If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.player-options.Vt2w8wXO7Xrjih0z]{Terra-Cotta Weaponry} ancestry feat, you can make a Dreadnought Slam with melee weapon Strikes for weapons you create and if the weapon is a two-handed melee weapon, you can ignore Trip’s requirement that you have a hand free.

Kaiju's Size (CC).name: Kaiju's Size (CC)
Kaiju's Size (CC).description: Your eidolon takes on the impossible dimensions of a kaiju. It becomes Gargantuan, instead of its previous size, and the reach on all its attacks increases to 20 feet. As an action, it may change its size to Medium, or to any other size available to it through an evolution feat, reducing its reach according to its new size.

Calm the Tempest.name: Calm the Tempest
Calm the Tempest.description:
Like the sea itself, one must be able to quell torrential moments. Choose up to 6 hostile creatures within 30 feet of you. Attempt a single @Check[diplomacy|against:will] Diplomacy check against the Will DC of each of the target creatures. Regardless of your result, each target is temporarily immune to your attempts to have it Calm the Tempest for 1 day.

Critical Success The creature listens to your call and can't use hostile actions for 1 minute. If you or one of your allies takes a hostile action against the creature this effect ends, but you and your allies can take hostile actions against the creature’s allies if those allies take a hostile action against you or your allies during the effect.

Success As critical success, except the duration is 1 round.

Memories of Youth.name: Memories of Youth
Memories of Youth.description:
All youths of Lingshen are taught the essential weapons of the nation. You still remember the time you spent learning these weapons. You are familiar with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.7tKkkF8eZ4iCLJtp]{Shortsword}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.kFZpTT1jI6UMfV9I]{Liuyedao}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.aXuJh4i8HqSu6NYV]{Longspear}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.0yiz254UI7DUFXWN]{Shuan Ji}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.hIgqLgH3YcLZBeoT]{Shortbow}—for the purposes of proficiency, you treat each of these weapons as simple weapons

If you are at least 5th level, critical hits you make with these weapons gain the weapon's critical specialization benefit.

Enhancement Your training extends beyond the standard. You are also familiar with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.player-options.jBIIaxSBQihLwp99]{Kampilan} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.KtarUneAx0hibGtW]{Nodachi} and for the purposes of proficiency, you treat each of these weapons as martial weapons.

Primordial Heart.name: Primordial Heart
Primordial Heart.description: Your eidolon’s heart is a swirling wellspring of ancient sorceries and primordial energies allowing it to rejuvenate its vigor in the heat of combat. Choose two energy damage types other than force. Whenever your eidolon deals one of those damage types with the damage from its unarmed attacks, or a damage type available to it through Energy Heart or Dual Energy Heart, it may instead deal one of the others. Your eidolon gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.misc.v4PgPuSIDHHqHtc9]{Primordial Regeneration} free action.

Project Location.name: Project Location
Project Location.description:
You create an astral beacon through a grand ritual, projecting your location into the cosmos. Choose a one word and a ten word message to attempt to project to your target when you begin casting the ritual.

Critical Success All targets know your location relative to them for 24 hours, as well as the ten-word message.

Success All targets know your location relative to them at the time you cast the ritual, as well as the one-word message.

Failure You fail to project your location to the target.

Critical Failure You project an incorrect location at least 100 miles away from you to the target, as well as the ten-word message.

Translucent Protection.name: Translucent Protection
Translucent Protection.description:
Trigger You are targeted by a Strike or spell that could deal fire or physical damage.

Requirements You’re channeling your dragon.

You turn translucent like water itself, allowing weapons to pass through you and fire to extinguish before contact. You gain resistance 20 to fire and to all physical damage from the triggering effect.

Horse Falconer.name: Horse Falconer
Horse Falconer.description:
Like many horse archers of Hongal, you’re bonded to an eagle, a trusted partner just like your mount and an invaluable hunting assistant. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.6yPrvbSDaa8glLjn]{Pet} general feat and the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.nowEaHgIyij7im8F]{Train Animal} skill feat, but you can use these feats only to gain and train eagles. Despite being a minion, your Pet eagle gains 1 reaction at the start of its turns, which it can use only to Aid you on a Nature, Perception, or Survival skill check (it still has to prepare to help you as normal for the Aid reaction). It automatically succeeds at its check to Aid you with those skills or automatically critically succeeds if you're a master of the skill in question.

Special Horse Falconer counts as the eagle hunter background for purposes of this benefit, which applies to only you and other characters with the eagle hunter background. If you already have the eagle hunter background, your Pet eagle also gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.2fiQzoEKu6YUnrU9]{Independent} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Le8UWr5BU8rV3iBf]{Tough} familiar abilities.

Qi-Siphoning Blow.name: Qi-Siphoning Blow
Qi-Siphoning Blow.description:
Trigger You critically hit an enemy with a Strike that dealt additional damage from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.misc.38Ks1K36sOWumo2f]{Qi-Empowered Blows}.

The rush of well-struck blows in battle causes your energy to return. You regain 1 Focus Point, which you can spend only to Energize a qi-shape action. If you don't spend this Focus Point by the end of your next turn, it is lost.

Ballad of Resilience.name: Ballad of Resilience
Ballad of Resilience.description:
You play a song that inspires resilience and fortitude.

Expert Allies who heard the song gain a +1 status bonus to their AC and Fortitude saves against effects that attempt to force them to move or knock them prone.

Master As expert, except the status bonus is +2.

Legendary As expert, except the status bonus is +3.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-tian-xia.misc.basjYFk5cnL7Wi1X]{Effect: Ballad of Resilience}

Projectile Empowerment.name: Projectile Empowerment
Projectile Empowerment.description: You have made a breakthrough in your understanding of qi which expands your connection to the world around you. When you use Qi-Empowered Blows, it applies to ranged Strikes in addition to your melee Strikes.

Locking Guard.name: Locking Guard
Locking Guard.description:
Trigger A creature within your reach critically fails a Strike against you with a weapon.

Requirements You are wielding two Minatan weapons.

You expertly parry and trap your enemy’s weapon between one of your weapons and their own body. Attempt a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} against the triggering creature. You do not need to have a hand free. If you succeed, the creature cannot take any action using the triggering weapon except to Release it until they are no longer grabbed. A creature can Release the weapon to automatically succeed at its Escape.

Fear of the Hunt.name: Fear of the Hunt
Fear of the Hunt.description: When prey is frightened, it makes mistakes which spiral inevitably to the hunter’s triumph. When you make a Strike against a foe that has the frightened condition, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your attack roll. If you make a successful Strike against a frightened enemy, its frightened condition can't decrease to less than 1 at the end of its turn.

Arindham's Whip (True).name: Arindham's Whip (True)
Arindham's Whip (True).description:
This leathery, moss-covered +3 major striking rooting whip is made from a petrified lizardfolk’s tongue, gnarled peachwood and Arindham’s whiskers. Foes who are bioengineered, artificial, or corrupted in some way, including but not limited to creatures with the aberration, construct, and undead traits, are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to you while they are immobilized by the whip’s rooting rune. You can use the following action when holding the whip.

Activate—Crack of the Vine 1 (manipulate) Frequency once per hour

Effect For 1 round, razor-sharp thorns cover Arindham’s whip—it loses the nonlethal trait and attacks also deal @Damage[6d4[bleed]] damage.

Flood Preparations.name: Flood Preparations
Flood Preparations.description: As a responder, you have developed the skills of creating shelters and barriers against natural disasters. You can spend 10 minutes assembling loose material, such as debris, wood, or sticks, to produce the effects of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.mwPfoYfVGSMAaUec]{Cozy Cabin} spell. Unlike the normal effects of the spell, your cozy cabin can withstand the winds of powerful storms, such as monsoons or hurricanes, for up to 1 hour before being destroyed. If you are a master in Crafting, the duration your cabin can survive in powerful storms is 8 hours instead of 1 hour, and if you are legendary in Crafting the frequency is reduced to once per hour.

Current Rider.name: Current Rider
Current Rider.description:
Trigger You end your turn in water with a current.

You have learned using the currents to your advantage is pivotal. You move up to twice your land Speed in the water. You can move in any direction except directly counter to the current (subject to GM discretion). This is forced movement.

Special If you have a swim Speed, you can move up to twice your swim Speed instead of your land Speed.
